notes.title: Community Announcement from your Community Manager
notes.content:
Greetings, Pilots. 
We have an important announcement from your Community Manager - Marcus a.k.a Chairborne.

[h3]Dear fellow Heliborners!

It's been two years now since I have begun working as the community manager for our beloved Heliborne. When I started I had high hopes of revitalizing the game and, like so many of you, ideas for new features. Due to other priorities and the use of resources for those, the expectations could not be fully realized. 

Now, it is time for me to move on. I thank all of you for your support and cooperation. I also want to express my thanks to each and every one at Klabater. For me, as someone who was not at all familiar with the gaming industry and comes from a totally different professional background, it was a pleasure working with them and I learned a whole lot of new skills.

Thank you all very much, both the community and devs and stay safe!

Markus[/h3]

notes.title: European Server Maintenance - Heliborne: EE
notes.content:
Greetings Pilots,

The servers in the European region are currently not working for Heliborne: Enhanced Edition (it works for Oldborne). This is due to server maintenance that is currently underway. We are in touch with our partners to minimize the effects on you, and we are working hard to ensure that the maintenance is completed as quickly as possible.

We are unable to provide an estimate of how long the maintenance will last, but rest assured that we are doing everything we can to manage it as quickly and efficiently as possible.

Please bear with us during this time, and we will keep you updated once the server is back. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Fly safe.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]
UPDATE:[/h2]

[h3]The servers are now working normally and everything is back to normal. Thank you, everyone, who was interrupted by the inconvenience, for your patience and understanding. [/h3]

notes.title: Connectivity Issues On Consoles
notes.content:
Hi there, Pilots!
[h3]
We've been reading your reports on the connectivity issues plaguing your playthroughs recently on [b]PS4[/b] and [b]Xbox[/b] - we’ve identified the possible key culprits behind these problems and we are currently investigating how to take care of these ASAP.[/h3]

To share some light on the source of the problem, it seems there are differences in the Photon service between PC and consoles, one of them causing a randomized problem affecting connection time out’s and eventual disconnections from server. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/5eea9c3b6f1f3c23e7fc7b93ba814c3fd940ab53.png[/img]

We are diligently working to fix the above on our end and we are in direct contact with the Photon support team.

We aim to resolve these issues by the [b]end of April[/b]. In the meantime, thanks a lot for your patience and understanding. 

Safe travels!

Klabater Team

notes.title: Chairborne as the new Heliborne Community Representative
notes.content:
Hello Heliborne Community,

My name is Markus, and some of you may know me under my in-game nickname [b]“Chairborne”[/b]. Being 45 years old, I am rather old for a gamer, or it only seems like that to me. Ever since the first 8-bit home computers came out in the mid-1980s, I enjoyed computer gaming, primarily military and simulation software. My professional background as a retired soldier and paramedic/firefighter has given me some inside look into the world of helicopters. So it is no wonder that once I came across Heliborne, back then still in early access, I immediately got hooked on the game. It is safe to say that with almost 2000 hours spent in-game, I am one of the more consistent fans of that wonderful piece of a game. Never before have I stuck to one simulation for so long. Now I have gotten the opportunity to do my tiny bit to help improve Heliborne and become a link between the developers and the community. There have been difficulties in the past and sometimes hard feelings, primarily due to misunderstandings as I see it. Believe me, monetary goals are not my motivation for getting engaged in this adventure. Instead, I want to make the gaming experience for all of us top-notch and serve as a connector for developers and gamers.

Moving forward, I will be managing the Steam forum and Discord channels, both Heliborne and Heliborne: Enhanced Edition, and doing my best to activate and connect you so that you get more chances to play in PvP or multiplayer. I will gladly listen to your feedback and ideas while we play together, so just let me know if you are ready on the #looking-to-play Discord channel:

[url=https://discord.gg/JZ9h6qbC7w][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/ec49ecfc994a9d0ecb084b082aed373f3d4f609c.gif[/img][/url]

The reasons Klabater hired me are the willingness of the devs to
- improve the information flow between you and them (bugs, improvements);
- moderate the chats and forums - propagating supportiveness towards new players, sharing constructive feedback, being polite and respectful to other community members; on the other hand, scattering or even banning for disrespectful behavior towards other players - feel free to DM me about any such situation;
- organize events to the extent the game allows, live stream on Heliborne Collection Steam page, do typical lets plays, etc.; in short - activating and bringing you together to enjoy the multiplayer modes.

Feel free to add me as a friend on Steam. Here is the link to my profile: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198065011131/
Chat, report, let me know if you’re willing to organize something together or live stream with me. I am sure it will be a pleasure to meet you and the devs much closer.

See you around!
Markus, aka Chairborne

notes.title: Heliborne Collection update
notes.content:
Greetings Pilots!

We have an important message and updates to pass on today. We’ll try to keep it short and not tl;dr. Briefly:

[b]New launcher - new Steam product name - Heliborne patch - Discord updates - brief development status[/b]

[h2]NEW GAME LAUNCHER[/h2]
In today’s patch, we introduced a new launcher. From now on, you can choose what Heliborne edition to play without switching between the branches. This will make the Heliborne game structure more transparent for the new customers, and we hope not much more complex for existing ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/95067aa5f80ad01c26b324a50a549fc25c52cc4b.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW STEAM PRODUCT NAME[/h2]
We implemented a new naming system - the main game on STEAM is now called [b]Heliborne Collection[/b]. It includes [b]Heliborne[/b] and [b]Heliborne Enhanced Edition[/b]. Both editions contain all the DLCs published so far, and all the future content will be mirrored for both.
Worry not; each Heliborne version will be actively updated - today, you get the patch for Heliborne, and the Heliborne Enhanced Edition patch will follow soon.
There will be a need to download both games, so expect a 13-16 GB of download (depending on the OS) with this update. Sorry for the inconvenience.

[h2]HELIBORNE PATCH 0.98.8[/h2]
[b]New patch arrives in Heliborne:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing objectives on Tonkin map.
[*] Added new standard camos (14 new skins).
[*] Fixed the loading screen, causing the game to hard lock.
[*] Removed placeholder "campaign settings" button.
[*] Fixed Nguyen map - mission 3 now loads in the correct order.
[*] Updated copyrighted helicopter names with community suggestions.
[/list]

[h2]DISCORD UPDATE[/h2]
[u]New discord server (servers structure) - a community update.
[/u]
We have set up a new separate Discord server for Heliborne Enhanced Edition users to split the communities and avoid misunderstandings.
A new server link: [url=https://discord.gg/kFzpMU8hRk]https://discord.gg/kFzpMU8hRk[/url]. Feel invited. Please first read the rules.
The current Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/w7rbapJmXv]https://discord.gg/w7rbapJmXv[/url] remains active with mindoug’s supervision.


[h2]DEVELOPMENT BRIEF STATUS[/h2]
[u]Consoles and PC development:[/u]

We will keep improving Heliborne Enhanced Edition - next patch ETA end of March 2021, and keep fixing ongoing issues/bugs in Heliborne - patch today. Please use the current Discord channel actively to inform us about contemporary matters.
We also submitted Heliborne Enhanced Edition for console certification to Microsoft and expect the game to be commercially available still in Q1’2021. Additionally, we are now solving specific network-related issues on PlayStation. The date of the commercial launch for this platform is still TBA. 


Thank you for playing and following!

Klabater Team

notes.title: Enhanced Edition — When the next update will be released?
notes.content:
Greeting pilots!

We haven't been releasing updates for a while, so let us tell you about what is happening with Heliborne development right now.

The team is currently working on fixes of the Enhanced Edition. We are planning to release the next update in mid-October. Although it should fix most of the known issues, we still want to take some time and hear your feedback before we would upload the Enhanced Edition back to the main branch. 

As of today, most of the visual issues are fixed. Right now, our priority is the UI. You gave us a lot of feedback in that regard, so we have completely rebuilt all the main screens, including squadron builder and battle rooms. Here are a few examples of how the squadron builder will look like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/db4c72550d1dde74507dbd06a3a222f56b3fac94.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/c72bd9606dd9c3221c334748aa9d076125679e82.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/348aaf93a85d63b2cc86eba00c13af08e4113671.png[/img]

If you think we should improve anything here for better user experience, please share your ideas in the comments. 

Meanwhile, part of the team is working on the Xbox One version. We already have a stable version with good performance and full gamepad compatibility. This week we will focus on the network. We aim to finish all the critical parts and features of the Xbox build by the end of October and then proceed with testing. 

P.S. If you are new to Heliborne and wondering why the game looks different from the screenshots on the store page: there is an older version of the game on the main branch, the updated version—Enhanced Edition—has been temporarily transferred to beta versions. You can easily switch to it several simple steps:
[olist]
[*] Find Heliborne — Enhanced Edition in Steam Library.
[*] Right-click on it and choose Properties.
[*] Go to the Betas tab and select “enhanced_edition” from the dropdown menu.
[*] Wait until the update is downloaded.
[/olist]

[b]Team Klabater[/b]

[list]
[*] New more multi-language friendly font updated on every dynamic text component in-game.
[*] Lobby GUI adjustments to better utilize screen space.

[/list]

Next on our lists are the following issues: 

1. Simplify terrain, water, tree shader for more performance.
2. Adjust fog distance and scene lighting.

notes.title: Dev Diaries #6—Sounds and Music
notes.content:
Greetings pilots!

Let's cover a bit more the updated sounds in Heliborne: Enhanced Edition. We've put a lot into more up-to-date and realistic graphics. And we want in-game sounds to conform.

When we talk about immersion, it is important what you see in front of you, but it is even more important is what you hear. The final goal is to make sounds support all the rest elements of the game in the right way and give you the ambiance that correlates to your expectations. That's how we described the sound task for ourselves.

[h2]What has been done already[/h2]

We have made quite a lot of new sound effects from scratch. Those are sounds of helicopters (engines and rotors), a variety of weapons, effects of explosions. Basically, what we consider as the primary and most important sound effects in Heliborne. You will be able to hear them in the game quite soon.

The next thing is the soundtrack. Although we like the original Heliborne soundtrack, we thought we could make it even better if we added distinctive and memorable compositions. And since we've added more night maps, they also needed a proper soundtrack.

Here are two examples:

[h3]Afghanistan[/h3]
[previewyoutube=6kEwRJ7E8Pg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Night Kosovo[/h3]
[previewyoutube=C8yEvmU6LlU;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think and whether you would like to hear the full compositions!

Besides that, we have refreshed the game's menu with UI sounds, so all your actions before a flight would also have audio feedback!

[h2]What is planned for later[/h2]

Some of the less critical sounds remain unchanged—for example, sounds of ground vehicles that you can only hear when you fly close to them. However, we do plan to update them too as soon as we have an opportunity.

[h2]What is not planned[/h2]

One of the questions bothering our voice actors was whether we are going to change the original community-made voice over. The answer is "No": we appreciate the community's input into the Heliborne development a lot and don't want the game to lose its charm.

Pilots!

We know how curious you are about Heliborne: Enhanced Edition. That’s why we decided to create more content from the dev team in the upcoming weeks!

Since today, every 2 weeks we will be posting “Dev Diary” in which you will be able to gain firsthand knowledge about the planned Enhanced Edition!

What’s more, every 2 weeks we are planning AMA sessions for you! If you have any questions about the game, save it and ask it during this Q & A sessions. Starting on the 16th of April on Heliborne’s Discord channel. At the first fire goes Roman, Game Designer of Heliborne!

Furthermore, during the recent AMA session in January, you asked how are we going to increase the number of players in the game. We told you that we are planning loads of actions and promos in the game. And the time has come! We would like to invite all of you to join us during first-ever Steam Free Weekend for Heliborne! During this weekend all Steam users will be able to download the game and play with you! We are planning loads of activities both for new players and veterans. And of course, you will have a chance to win some cool prizes during the whole weekend! Save the date in your calendar - 8th to 11th of May!

Last but not least, LIVE STREAMS! First one - 14th of April on Heliborne Steam card. This time, we will be playing some PvE missions :)

And now, the main thing! Update on Heliborne: Enhanced Edition works and development!

1. Improved multiplayer engine and a matchmaking system

In our survey form, in which we asked you to let us know about the most anticipated changes and improvements, many among you mentioned multiplayer engine update in the first place. We decided to focus on this feature What’s more, we decided to add matchmaking to make PvP even more competitive. In our plans there is also a  new rank system, but we will confirm it in more details later. 

2. Moved the game to a newer version of the engine (new Unity)

Upgrade for new Unity engine is mostly required to port the game for consoles. That’s the main advantage of this point development-wise, but let’s not forget that the game obviously looks much better already thanks to this change. 

3. A new UI project has been created - we are currently implementing it

Some of you reported that UI is good enough, but many stressed the fact that we should modernize it a bit as it is already visually outdated. Sooo… We made it more clear readable. You will be able to see the results of our work on our Facebook and VK pages this Saturday on #ScreenshotSaturday! 

4. Optimization of existing maps, change of lighting system and post-processes - ongoing

Heliborne has never been a challenging game for your PCs, but we received reports, that in some areas your FPS drops. That’s why we decided to check all maps and polish them. On some, we changed the lighting system. With those changes and new UI Enhanced Edition will look gorgeous!

Hope you will like this kind of messages and see you on stream!

Over and out!

Friends!

We are happy to let you know that today we’ve launched a crowdfunding campaign for Help Will Come Tomorrow, a true-born survival game and another step in Klabater’s bold journey in search of meaningful, story-driven games. 

You will find our campaign here: klabater.com/HWCT_Kickstarter  

We encourage you to support the game! :)

We soooo are happy to finally unveil more details about Help Will Come Tomorrow. The game was shown during Gamescom 2019 previously, and we are now in a much more advanced stage of development. This is why we decided to add a demo, to let everyone know that Help Will Come Tomorrow is already in a good shape. We really think that we have found our own unique approach to survival game formula, with a more narrative-driven and psychological touch.

Help Will Come Tomorrow crowdfunding campaign is supported with many new game-related materials, among them screens and artwork, but above all else we encourage you to check:

notes.title: Heliborne 0.98.5 — Co-op Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885942/dee3edf9f9eb9f471c49ad64912d2f258ee6c2a4.jpg[/img]

Greetings pilots,

Today we are happy to introduce you a PvE objectives update for three game maps: Night Kosovo, Sahara, and Binomo Islands. They feature two completely new large-scale PvE missions, Amphibious Landing and Tank Attack, as well as several other improvements to the cooperative game mode.

Be ready to check them out!

[h1]Changelog 0.98.5:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Night Kosovo PvE mode has been reworked — now it's Counter-insurgency. Players need to contain enemy attacks and provide logistical support to allies on the ground.
[*] New large-scale PvE objectives on Binomo Islands:
[list]
[*] Support amphibious landing of allied naval assault force,
[*] Defend against enemy amphibious landing.
[/list]
[*] New large-scale PvE objectives for Sahara and Night Kosovo:
[list]
[*] Defend against enemy tank attack.
[/list]
[*] New PvE objective for Sahara:
[list]
[*] Search and eliminate enemy artillery batteries.
[/list]
[*] Award points when other players use cargo (repair kits and ammo crates) you have transported have been introduced.
[*] Door gunners' angle on IAR-330L has been fixed. Price of A-129 modifications has been slightly changed.
[*] Portuguese localisation has been updated (obrigado SpreeK).
[*] Other bug-fixes and improvements.
[/list]

[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.98 — Reinforcements
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/bed7c4c14408ce55f6c8a641ffb3b0499f9ee305.jpg[/img]

Greetings pilots!

Good news from Heliborne hangar: it got 4 new helicopters. Two of them are Chinese attack helicopter Z-10 and Chinese attack reconnaissance Z-19 available for the Soviet-Russian side. The NATO side has received two European birds: German scout Bo 105 and Italian attack reconnaissance A129 Mangusta.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/aec99072bf8020da8fa92d77401413a0d4ca56dc.jpg[/img]

And now you also have several additional options to test them. We've added single and cooperative PvE to the biggest Heliborne maps Khost and Binomo Islands, both over 70 sq. km! Together with PvE functionality they have got exclusive PvE game mode — Counter-Insurgency. You need to defeat or contain enemy insurgency, find and destroy enemy staging grounds, protect and provide logistical support to existing positions. Apart from that, the Binomo map will receive several more thematic PvE objectives with a separate mini-patch by the end of the week.

All of that will be even more lively than before thanks to new background radio chatter which will accompany your and your team's activity. 

And we also have a special treat for Spanish-speaking pilots. From now on Heliborne is fully available in Spanish language! Send all your love to our Mexican player Raul Valenzuela who's done all of that work alone. 

To commemorate the update we announce a -50% discount for the base Heliborne game which will start tomorrow at 10 AM US Pacific Time / 5 PM GMT and will last for 4 days! 

[h1]Heliborne 0.98 changelog:[/h1]
[list][*]Four new helicopters: 
- German scout [b]Bo 105[/b], 
- Italian attack reconnaissance [b]A129 Mangusta[/b], 
- Chinese attack helicopter [b]Z-10[/b],
- Chinese attack reconnaissance [b]Z-19[/b].
[*]Two biggest maps, each with more than 70 sq. km of operational area, that previously were PvP only now available in single and cooperative PvE — Khost and Binomo.
[*]New PvE game mode for these maps — Counter-Insurgency. You need to defeat or contain enemy insurgency, find and destroy enemy staging grounds, protect and provide logistical support to existing positions.
[*]Counter-Insurency game mode features 15 new objective types besides some objectives from existing PvE game modes. Also this game mode has objective sequencing mechanic. Objectives relate to each other and build up into bigger operation in certain area of the map.
[*]New background radio chatter: your and your team's activity now will have radio chatter footprint.
[*]Various improvements and fixes.
[*]Spanish translation.[/list]

[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.97 — Sahara Desert
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/0b67e1ba2adc664070424b932adf478e8e83f518.jpg[/img]
Greetings, pilots! We've been working on the update 0.97 for some time, and now we are happy to unveil our new map — North Africa, Sahara. This desert map is designed for II generation helicopter squads and is available both in PvP and PvE modes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/49faef190faea95f71ffd7a1a22ae57312af45a1.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/2e553e2517d2583f862ec8054a5e9f145fd8e737.jpg[/img]

Operation Fznamznon map has also been improved. We've added several ships which guard carriers from enemy helicopters and basically defend your spawn point. Nguyen Hue has received new visual effect and improved PvE mode.

[h1]Heliborne 0.97 full changelog:[/h1]
[list][*]New map - North Africa, Sahara for 2nd generation, both PvP and PvE versions.
[*]Additions to Fznamznon map - several ships will guard each spawn and landing ship location. Be aware, those ships are armed with heavy missiles.
[*]Visual changes on operation Nguyen map - new rice fields, camera settings, rice field water splash effect.
[*]Additions to PvE on operation Nguyen map - new unit locations and also experiment with boats on the water.
[*]On both of 2nd generation maps tanks will now shoot at nearby helicopters with their main gun. Don't hover close to them.
[*]Fixed some UI problems and improved some effects (40mm and 57mm AA gun effect)
[*]Added "additional timer" option to PvE setup. This option will allow you to make either extend or reduce default objective timer.
[*]Timer for rescue objectives now will be tied not only to difficulty setting, but also to size of the map. Allowing for more time to pick up soldiers.
[*]Soldiers intended for rescuee now will be grouped closer. Soldier callback/pick up range is extended. And from now on soldiers will try not to climb up the electric poles. Fixed problem with rescuee soldiers not willing to take empty seats in some cases.
[*]Recon soldiers requesting evacuation under fire will now mark their position with purple smoke.
[*]Some of the PvE objectives now will specify grid coordinates of the objective.
[*]Fixes to training map - armor values of training targets are updated. Some changes in target visual effects.
[*]Heavy machinegun fire adjusted. Each bullet will deal less damage, but machinegun itself will fire for a longer period of time.
[*]ATGM missiles should stop "crashing" enemy helicopters in some cases and will count as a regular kill.
[*]Visual fixes for several helicopters.[/list]

[h1]Heliborne Flight School[/h1]

Apart from that, we would like to announce Heliborne Flight School. The School will be made in a form of regular online battles, mostly PvP. Cadets will be split into 2 teams, and each of the teams will be led by one of our top players. Teams will be able to chat in a special private voice channel in our Discord.

If you would like to get advice from the most experience Heliborne players, be sure to reserve a place! Please [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdrdi28Nvt4uHbDd0eiZTO9aOxhzZBV5qQu9Fg2ACj6dfTvVw/viewform?usp=sf_link]fill in this short questionnaire[/url]. Those who want to share their experience with others are also encouraged to fill in the form.

[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.96.8 — New Co-op objectives
notes.content:
Greetings, pilots!

The Dragon's Awakening event has been successfully finished. You all did a great job, and it's now time for awards!

Every special medal earned within the event will give you a unique thematic Chinese camouflage.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/142199b651d3eb9a4ac2f0d7a38f88f20520c971.jpg[/img]

We also would like to ask how did you like the event? What did you like most of all? What should we improve next time? Help us to make every next event better than the ones before! 

[h1]Heliborne 0.96.8[/h1]
Great news for Co-op players: we have added several new types of Co-op objectives and improved Co-op overall. We've also made scout helicopters more valuable, but a bit shortened their markable area range.

More Co-op updates will follow soon!

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list][*]Difficulty settings for Co-op now affect accuracy and target contact range both for AA guns and vehicles.
[*]Health of AA guns on III and IV generation maps has been increased.
[*]New Co-op objectives have been added: insert operation under fire, reconnaissance group evacuation from ambush, medevac, and reconnaissance operation.
[*]Appearance logic of several objectives has been changed: less objectives deep behind enemy lines, less objectives which lead to spawn of enemies in close vicinity to player's helicopter, etc.
[*]50-seconds enemy spawn delay has been added to "engage enemy convoy" objective.
[*]Time limits for objectives on easy and medium difficulty levels have been slightly increased. Several new options for number of simultaneous objectives have been added.
[*]Chance of positive event after successfully carried out objective has been slightly decreased on all difficulty levels.
[*]Air-to-air and Manpad missiles have received guaranteed damage depending on their power. Overall, air-to-air missiles became more effective, but will not inflict more damage than before.
[*]MANPAD's missile smoke trail is now starting higher from the ground. 
[*]Shooting accuracy and range of RPG soldiers have been slightly increased. [*]Also, group of RPG soldiers now communicate with each other and does not make double shot in the same target.
[*]Fixed RPG grenade bug which incorrectly lowered its damage.
[*]RPG grenade rules for damaging helicopters have been changed: now it inflicts guaranteed damage.
[*]Enemy RPG and MANPADS in Co-op now have unlimited number of shots.
[*]Targets marked by scout helicopters now have additional "request for attack" icon above them.
[*]Markable area range for scout helicopters has been decreased from 100 to 70 meters. As a result, markable area size has been decreased around two times, but it's still enough to cover any landing zone.
[*]Target auto-lockon for cannons has been improved. It's now being activated much more often. Hence "mark target" button for scouts has been moved from B to E by default, while manual lockon has been moved from E to B.
[*]Improvements of Chinese localization (thanks to Danyu-Tom, Pvt.Petrenko, and Chinese players group).[/list]
[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.96 — Dragon's Awakening
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/7f4d83ea6275801b67b76be1af4bb6a679224b06.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! We have several great new for you. First of all, Heliborne has received a new map — Binomo Islands, Operation Fznamznon. 
https://youtu.be/xK8MDIdn5hQ
[h1]The Map[/h1]

Operation Fznamznon is IV generation hypothetical scenario with an amphibious assault on an island located in South China Sea. It introduces a lot of brand new gameplay features. 60 percent of its 69 square kilometers are occupied by an island, the other part is sea. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d52344f8ac718383fbfdf4ffad0bcc21a46c195e.jpg[/img]

The map is based on Frontline game mode with several significant changes. The biggest one is that instead of ground bases players start battle on heavy aircraft carriers. Those are USS Wasp (LHD-1) on US side and heavy aircraft-carrying missile cruiser Novorossiysk on Soviet side. They need to support an assault on the island, providing cover to the amphibious troops on their way to the shore and after that support the Marines while they are advancing through the island.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gTfUEn3.gif[/img]

The map’s fleet also include dock landing ships (Ivan Rogov and USS Rushmore (LSD-47)), which deploy light armored vehicles and cover them until they reach the ground, and hovercrafts (Zubr and LCAC-1), which transport ground vehicles to the island.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FOJjksG.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/a5f1ba96a3af0260dc4ad62eae5b304f769470fa.jpg[/img]

Currently, Operation Fznamznon is available in PvP only, but we are going to add it to Co-op later.

We are currently looking into possible scenarios to expand sea operations related gameplay in the future. Looking forward to your feedback on this map and gameplay and waiting for your suggestions on how we could make it better!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/406c8fdb956b9378447a01a36ac46fd91073ef60.jpg[/img]

[h1]Chinese localization[/h1]

Today we are also happy to greet our new Chinese pilots on-board and present official Chinese localization for Heliborne! 欢迎您！

To commemorate this significant step in the game's development we've prepared a special in-game event — [b]Dragon's Awakening[/b]. The event will last for 10 days during which everyone will be able to unlock unique helicopter camouflages and helmet patches.

[h1]The Manuscript[/h1]

To all pilots,
Heliborne HQ has received an ancient Chinese manuscript from secret sources. Our translators and decoders have been working for months until they have finally discover its content. The manuscript is based on The Art of War by Sun Tzu and reveals how to become an invincible warrior. With the help of Chinese masters we've been able to adapt this knowledge to helicopter warfare.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9c8ae56bde9310df367987b617a176d4f2890b7e.png[/img]

[h1]The Objectives[/h1]

Pilots, during the next 10 days, until June 24th 23:55 GMT, you'll have several temporary achievements available. Those are Tiger, Fox, Horse, and Dragon medals. Each of them has several objectives which have to be fulfilled during one battle. 

Dragon medal can be received only by those who already have Tiger, Fox, and Horse medals!

[b]1. Tiger medal[/b]
In one battle, complete 2 of 3 objectives:
	- Destroy 25 ground vehicles
	- Shot down 5 helicopters
	- Destroy 10 AA positions

[b]2. Fox medal [/b]
In one battle, complete 2 of 3 objectives:
	- Scout 35 targets
	- 15 spotted targets destroyed by your teammates 
	- Destroy 20 special soldiers

[b]3. Horse medal [/b]
In one battle, complete 2 of 3 objectives:
	- Capture 5 Landing Zones
	- Show down 2 helicopters with MANPADs
	- 10 targets destroyed by your mortars	

[b]4. Dragon medal[/b]
After Tiger, Fox, and Horse medals are received:
	- Destroy 30 ground targets with door gunners
	- Get ATGM-sniper 1st class ribbon (destroy 8 enemy vehicles with 8 ATGMs in a row)

[h1]The Awards[/h1]

Every medal will unlock a unique helicopter camouflage after the event is finished. 

Good luck, pilots!

[h1]Heliborne 0.96 changelog:[/h1]
[list][*] New map has been added — Binomo Islands, Operation Fznamznon (available in PvP only, will be added to Co-op later).
[*] Operation Fznamznon map features updated Frontline mode: additional LZ which trigger deployment of vehicles have been added. Those LZs help to push forward on the map much faster, and without them being captured it is impossible to follow some of the routes.
[*] New UI showing progression during special events. 
[*] 4 new medals available during Dragon's Awakening event.
[*] Hit sounds for helicopters have been improved: they now depend on caliber of a gun (thanks to ChokDK).
[*] Other sounds have been added: reconnaissance failure, picking up cargo (thanks to ChokDK).
[*] Some bugs have been fixed (cargo, choosing of a helicopter), opacity slider for night maps has been added, team chat has been added as default, cargo has been added to the training map.
[*] 5 missing helmet patches have been added to Deluxe Camouflage Pack.
[*] Chinese Camouflage Pack has been added.[/list]
We've also prepared some new features which we did not include into this update. They will be added within following days.

[h1]Heliborne 0.96.1 changelog:[/h1]
[list][*] Armoring on vehicles has been unified on all maps. Overall, some vehicles became a little bit more armored, without significant changes.
[*] Adjusted weapons of light vehicles on 3/4 generation maps. Vehicles will shoot for longer time, but each round will be less lethal.
[*] Bonus to spotting range in ATGM mode, far turret zoom and artillery aim now is given only to scout helicopters. 
[*] Fixed UI for "8 ATGM kill-streak condition". Condition itself is reworked and should work without problems.
[*] Fixed UI for several medals.
[*] Added secondary cargo spawn location on new map.
[*] Fixed turrets of LSD-47 on new map.
[*] Fixed various bugs in achievements, game results, visual effects.[/list]


[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.95 — Pre-Battle Lobbies
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/2c91a35f83dbf65a3cf8f458c6bf07f3edbac3f8.jpg[/img]

Greetings, pilots!

We have very good news: a long-awaited lobby system has finally been added to Heliborne! 

Now you can [b]create a lobby[/b] to gather more players before starting a battle. You can both wait until other players join or invite your Steam and Discord friends. 

You had a great battle with an unknown pilot and would like to play together in future? We made it much easier to socialize with others: now each battle ends with a [b]post-battle lobby[/b] where you'll be able to talk to other pilots and send them friend invitations.

Take a look at the full patch notes to learn more details about the Update 0.95:
[list][*]This update adds "lobbies" or "pre-game rooms". How they work - now when you creating a multiplayer game (be it Coop or PvP) - you can choose an option to Gather Players and create pre-game room. People will be able to join that pregame room and a battle will be started when you (host) will decide to do so. We hope to utilize this new feature a lot more in upcoming PvE overhaul and additional PvP gameplay modes.
[*]While in a pre-game room you will have access to pre-game chat, where you can talk with other players.
[*]Also while you are in a pre-game room, you will be able to send join invites through Steam and Discord to your friends.
[*]We've integrated Steam Rich Presence - you will be able to send invites to both in-game and off-game friends. And you will be able to join games of your friends from the Steam interface (Join game buttons in friend list and profile list). This depends on privacy settings of your Steam profile.
[*]We also integrated Discord Rich Presence - you will be able to invite your friends to both pre-game and on-going matches. Also, information about details of what you are playing will be displayed in your Discord profile. This integration also depends on your Discord privacy settings.
[*]Steam friend list menu is added to the game. Through it, you can message your Steam friends, find their current battle or invite them to a pre-game room you are currently in.
[*]Now after all multiplayer games participant list will be displayed in a post-game menu. You will be able to check other player's in-game profile (helmet, rank, and medals) and send them friend invites.
[*]Also, a post-game chat will be displayed after all multiplayer games.
[*]Planet Plyuk map is now hidden from both PvP and PvE. We'll do something with it in future, meanwhile, a new game map is in its finishing stages and should arrive to the game soon.
[*]Meanwhile, we've added Kosovo Night map to the list of Coop-playable maps.
[*]Achievement for mortar support (Love-tube) was fixed.
[*]Maximum team difference rules where changed. For teams of size 3 or less maximum team difference is now 1, for size of 4 and more — 2, like before.
[*]Password protection menu changed — now it is one password for the battle itself, not per-team.
[*]Coop settings menu changed — it looks differently and now allows for more option combinations.
[*]Increased rocket, missile, and personnel reload speed. Rocket refill speed now different for small caliber and large caliber rockets.[/list]

Oh, and we are going to show you something special very soon, so stay tuned!

[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.92 — The Transport Renaissance
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/a89dee8405925878973d3721ff96cd0a995800f6.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Pilots!

We've issued an update which will definitely make your day. And there are several reasons.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tC2lfhSeGuQ
First, it's a special day for transport helicopters — they are finally able to do sling loading! We've added two initial types of cargo — ammo crates and repair kit. Expect more in upcoming updates.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/ea650e1631ff29110552a742f1f1975f6f491a85.jpg[/img]

Second, we've finally introduced Steam Achievements. There are 50 of them at the moment. More are coming. Start earning them, you'll need them soon! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/60a969dce818001536be44941565bf956cf14113.jpg[/img]

Third, you may now choose a size of a room, from 3x3 to 8x8 (depending on a map).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/ba25f191a2f0e7b1e9bb493a097ebf8f3ab16228.jpg[/img]

Also, good news for owners of Logitech controllers: we've recently introduced native support for Logitech 3D Pro, X52 HOTAS, X52 Pro HOTAS, and X56 HOTAS.

[h1]Full patch notes:[/h1]
[list][*]Sling Loading. The first two cargo types — ammo and repair kit crates. Transport helicopters can pick them up at bases and move anywhere on a map to create a reload/repair point for other helicopters.
[*]Steam Achievements. The first 50 achievements have been added. More will be added in future.
[*]Automatic Pre-Battle Slot Reservation System has been introduced. This will prevent simultaneous connection of several players for the same side and thus will help balance battles.
[*]Correlation between vehicle armour and explosion damage has been updated. Medium and heavy armoured vehicles now receive less damage from fragments. It also depends on an armour of an affected part of a vehicle.
[*]Online Single-player Mode. Those who want to play solo and earn progression points may now play this new game mode instead of password protected multiplayer battle. However, we recommend to play Heliborne with other players — this is what it has been designed for.
[*]Flight model has been updated. Now high speed during dipping down may be achieved only together with Collective Increase (Space button). Altitude gaining rules have been updated as well.
[*]Repair time and experience bonuses for outnumbered teams (1+ players) have been added to PvP modes. 
[*]Room size settings have been added to PvP: a host can limit number of players for a battle.
[*]The last used camouflage (including Hangar) will be remembered and automatically applied when you add a helicopter to a squad.
[*]AA sight on a one Mi-28N modification has been fixed.
[*]Mortars info has been added to the after-battle report.
[*]Net code fixes.
[*]Hidden fixes for the next upcoming updates.
[*]Native support for the following Logitech controllers has been introduced: 3D Pro, X52 HOTAS, X52 Pro HOTAS, and X56 HOTAS.[/list]

[b]Special thanks to TRUMP's warhammer, KapukiCram, Sheepify, and Erkeo for help in preparing Steam achievements.[/b]

[i][h1]Team JetCat[/h1][/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/60a969dce818001536be44941565bf956cf14113.jpg[/img]

Third, you may now choose a size of a room, from 3x3 to 8x8 (depending on a map).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/ba25f191a2f0e7b1e9bb493a097ebf8f3ab16228.jpg[/img]

Also, good news for owners of Logitech controllers: we've recently introduced native support for Logitech 3D Pro, X52 HOTAS, X52 Pro HOTAS, and X56 HOTAS.

[h1]Full patch notes:[/h1]
[list][*]Sling Loading. The first two cargo types — ammo and repair kit crates. Transport helicopters can pick them up at bases and move anywhere on a map to create a reload/repair point for other helicopters.
[*]Steam Achievements. The first 50 achievements have been added. More will be added in future.
[*]Automatic Pre-Battle Slot Reservation System has been introduced. This will prevent simultaneous connection of several players for the same side and thus will help balance battles.
[*]Correlation between vehicle armour and explosion damage has been updated. Medium and heavy armoured vehicles now receive less damage from fragments. It also depends on an armour of an affected part of a vehicle.
[*]Online Single-player Mode. Those who want to play solo and earn progression points may now play this new game mode instead of password protected multiplayer battle. However, we recommend to play Heliborne with other players — this is what it has been designed for.
[*]Flight model has been updated. Now high speed during dipping down may be achieved only together with Collective Increase (Space button). Altitude gaining rules have been updated as well.
[*]Repair time and experience bonuses for outnumbered teams (1+ players) have been added to PvP modes. 
[*]Room size settings have been added to PvP: a host can limit number of players for a battle.
[*]The last used camouflage (including Hangar) will be remembered and automatically applied when you add a helicopter to a squad.
[*]AA sight on a one Mi-28N modification has been fixed.
[*]Mortars info has been added to the after-battle report.
[*]Net code fixes.
[*]Hidden fixes for the next upcoming updates.
[*]Native support for the following Logitech controllers has been introduced: 3D Pro, X52 HOTAS, X52 Pro HOTAS, and X56 HOTAS.[/list]

[b]Special thanks to TRUMP's warhammer, KapukiCram, Sheepify, and Erkeo for help in preparing Steam achievements.[/b]

[i][h1]Team JetCat[/h1][/i]

notes.content:

[quote][h1]HELIBORNE HEADQUARTERS[/h1]

For immediate distribution to all pilots.

[u]SUBJECT[/u]: OPERATION WINTER OFFENSIVE, 6-8 February 2018.

[u]MISSION[/u]: Fulfill following objectives to receive unique air efficiency awards. The awards may be received during the Operation only.

[u]OBJECTIVES[/u]: Every medal requires a certain number of objectives to be fulfilled; pilots may choose any objective(-s) from the lists. The objectives must be fulfilled in a single battle, either PvP or PvE. At the event’s conclusion each player will receive a reward corresponding with the highest medal earned. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/da717bbcec9ee8dfa63c9a059bf18aefcfe9e1ab.png[/img]
[b]3rd Class Winter Offensive Service Medal[/b] (one objective to be fulfilled):
• Capture 3 Landing Zones
• Destroy 8 ground vehicles 
• Destroy 4 helicopters
• Scout 40 targets

[b]2nd Class Winter Offensive Service Medal[/b] (two objectives to be fulfilled):
• Capture 7 Landing Zones
• Defend 7 Landing Zones from enemy attacks
• Destroy 10 tanks
• Destroy 20 AA positions
• Destroy 10 helicopters
• Spotting resulted in 20 destroyed targets
• Deploy mortar troops which will destroy 15 targets

[b]1st Class Winter Offensive Service Medal[/b] (three objectives to be fulfilled):
• Destroy 10 ground vehicles with RPG soldiers
• Destroy 3 helicopters with MANPADs
• Spotting resulted in 35 destroyed targets
• Destroy 2 helicopters with door gunners
• Destroy 20 helicopters with machine gun or cannon 
• Destroy 30 ground vehicles with ATGM
• Return helicopter in critical condition to base 3 times (less than 10% HP; press G to return a helicopter)
[/quote]

In case of a successful outcome of the operation, the pilots awarded with medals of distinction will be assigned to additional awards:
[list][*]For 3rd Class Medal — commemorative helmet patch.
[*]For 2nd Class Medal — commemorative helmet patch and helmet.
[*]For 1st Class Medal — commemorative helmet patch, helmet, and unique UH-1D Bundesgrenzschutz camouflage.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/cc0daeb81eae05a608ce4b10ea9f36a189f56ec5.jpg[/img]

The Operation Winter Offensive is the first in-game event in 2018. It also serves us as a test run for other events which are planned for following months. Your feedback is extremely valuable!

Good luck, pilots!
[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: The New Year Update 0.89
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/6a116a4cac01128baec67bf6526c7792df45665e.jpg[/img]

Pilots, Heliborne 0.89 is the last update of the year. What a year it's been though, a year we can’t thank you enough for. Today's update, however, is a bit smaller than we planned as we've run into some technical issues with some of the planned features we were going to put in this update and have decided to delay their inclusion in the game until a later update coming in the new year. We apologize for this, but we'd rather get a working feature to you than a buggy and broken one. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

[h1]Heliborne 0.89 changelog:[/h1]
[list][*]2 New Helicopters have been added to the game, the Ansat and the CH-46.
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/6e29886c4a241f7f5cbc38bf7df017f84acca198.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/2744741e102a762609c73de75f8704a0f8a9007a.jpg[/img][/url]      [url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/46d3c7f1f3937e04b091df77c69c3f3e86edde78.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/f1ba01ccb3fc88a549bff7cd847dc67c5878b4de.jpg[/img][/url]
[*]Festive camos have been added for the Mi-8T, Mi-24V, UH-1D and AH-1S. These camos are temporary and have been added for holiday period only.
[*]Added camera sway from wind when a helicopter is hovering. This can be disabled via the Settings menu.
[*]Added a camera shake when colliding with the ground or receiving a large amount of damage.
[*]Changed the logic behind helicopter module damage. Now, after a module has taken critical damage, any additional damage is applied to the helicopters main hull until it is destroyed.
[*]Changed turret angles for most helicopters with turrets. The angles have been changed according to real values, this results in a 20-30% increase overall on turret angles. 
[*]Changed vehicle targeting calculations. Ground vehicles will shoot more often and in more situations.
[*]Repair times now account for spent ammunition when changing a helicopter at the main base.
[*]RPG Soldier reload speed when shooting at ground targets is now 11 seconds, down from 19.
[*]Fixed IRCM reload error when landed at a base.
[*]Fixed aiming angle for air-to-air missiles on some helicopters.
[*]Added Estonian language, thanks to Valvejoodik for translation.[/list]

[h1]Happy New Year, pilots!
Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne Winter Complete Edition
notes.content:
Greetings, pilots! The new year is just a few days away and we want to celebrate the end of the year 2017 with a special Heliborne bundle which includes everything we’ve made so far — [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5270/Heliborne_Winter_Complete_Edition/]Winter Complete Edition[/url]. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/dcf8a1cb14f567beb243b8f4ee085f98819976f1.jpg[/img]
If you have ever wanted to get all the camouflage packs this is perfect time at least for three reasons:
1) you will get 26% discount for a bundle,
2) you will get an additional discount for everything you have purchased already,
3) the bundle comes with a new [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/749242/Heliborne__Winter_Camouflage_Pack/]Winter Camouflage Pack[/url] which is available for limited time.

[h1]Upcoming updates[/h1]
We have at least one content update planned by the end of this year with an ability to carry cargo as the main feature. It should have been released together with the Winter Complete Edition, but due to scheduling issues, we have to separate them. Game update will follow in upcoming days. Sorry for inconveniences.

The next one will introduce a lot of changes to Coop/PvE: additional PvE map (one of those which are PvP exclusive at the moment), new types of objectives, changes to existing maps and mechanics, a new behavior for ground troops, etc. We also want to improve difficulty settings and give you far more parameters to adjust.

Some of the things planned for Early 2018:
- Pre-game lobby,
- Updated sounds,
- New helicopters for existing nations,
- Daily/weekly tasks,
- Lifetime awards and leaderboards,
- Sea map.

Many thanks for your support!
[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.87.7 — Updated Controls
notes.content:
Hello Pilots!

Update 0.87.7 is live! This is the third post-release Heliborne update. Its cornerstone is a big change to simple control scheme which allows players to turn without losing air speed. We believe that all pilots will benefit from it, especially new ones.

This update mostly fixes and adjustments of various gameplay issues. Upcoming updates will introduce sling-loading and extensions to coop gameplay.

[h1]Version 0.87.7 changelog:[/h1]
[list][*]Changes to simple controls - now when you try to turn without additionally pressing A/D - you'll have slow steady turn without losing a lot of air speed, if you additionally press A/D - you'll have the same turning speed as before
[*]Changes to a number of helicopters and their flight parameters
[*]A lot of transport helicopters from gen 2 to gen 4 health values were improved
[*]Prices for transport loadouts of some helicopters from gen 3 and gen 4 were lowered
[*]Several helicopters received changes to their respawn time after death (mostly faster respawn for less armed loadouts)
[*]Treacherous map borders on Tonkin map are extended
[*]Air-to-air Stinger and Igla missiles got their damage slightly reduced (by 10% or so), they should not be one hit - one kill missiles for most of the modern attack helicopters. R-60 and AIM-9 received no changes.

[*]Heat seeker missiles turning speed after successful flares is lower - its easier to avoid them by maneuvering after long-range flaring
[*]Heat seeker missiles locking cone is smaller on distance now - you need to actually keep your aim on target for some time
[*]MANPADS missile turning speed is a bit better
[*] MANPADS squadron price is 12 now
[*] MANPADS will now shoot no more than 2 missiles per 10 seconds on 1 helicopter from 1 location (70m radius)
[*]Most of modern ATGMs max speed is lowered by 20-30%
[*]Now ATGM aim will work without wiggling in flight if you are aiming at something directly along your helicopter's current course
[*]TRS-132 and M-8 rocket damage increased by 30%
[*]Minor network improvements
[*]Saitek X52 default layout - thanks to rada660
[/list]

Fly safe!
[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: One week after the Release (Update 0.87)
notes.content:
Hey Pilots!

One week has passed since Heliborne has been officially released. And it’s been a really good time for the game: a lot of players having fun 24/7, dozens of new Heliborne streamers on Twitch and YouTube, media coverage worldwide. This is so great and exciting, especially for such a small team and project as ours! 

Even more exciting is how fast our community is growing. You guys are awesome! It’s a pleasure to see how active and dedicated you are. We’ve received tons of good ideas and advice how to make Heliborne great again. Will be done!

Heliborne community has also started to work on [url=http://heliborne.wikia.com/wiki/Heliborne_Wiki]Heliborne wiki[/url] — feel free to use and expand it, any help is highly appreciated!

Meanwhile, Team JetCat has been working hard all the week to deliver you the first post-release update. In this update we have addressed the most pressing issues and also added new features:
	[list][*]first batch of netcode improvements to provide better network synchronization;
	[*]updated mechanics for AA missiles and flares;
	[*]several new types of door gunners;
	[*]mortar teams will now give a reward to players who deploy them.[/list]
The next update will be more focused on new content.

And the last thing for today. You probably remember how the Mighty Jingles helped us on the release? We decided to give him something special in return. Greet a new British camouflage for UH-1D with a logo of the overlord! It’s added into the progression as an additional camouflage which means everyone can get it. More neat stuff for the Jingles subscribers is coming, stay tuned!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/7eb470fc50f473da42eb530b0dddead8b4b53309.png[/img]
[h1]Update 0.87 changelog:[/h1]
[list][*]An interval between in-game background music tracks has been shortened.
[*]New RPG/SMAW smoke trails.
[*]The 'death cam' will show enemy helicopter more accurately.
[*]First stage of Steam friends integration. Battles with your friends in them are now the highest ones in the battle list, your friends' names are green in-game now, also now you can check steam profiles of players from your last battle in Steam - View - Players.
[*]Filters of a battle list will be active in-between the battles, battles are now showing sides correctly.
[*]Cabin gunner in Mi-8MTV and Mi-8TV has been relegated to door gunners.
[*]New door gunners: AGS-17 (grenade launcher) and NSV Utes (12,7mm) for Mi-8MTV, NSV Utes for Ka-27, paired M-60 for UH-1D.
[*]Door gunners with M60 have been added to UH-1B.
[*]Flares, if they blind a missile, will deflect a missile way farther (50 meters instead of 10) in direction of deployed flares.
[*]Slight change to Flare chance to blind missiles on long distances
[*]Air-to-air missile (R-60&AIM-9) mechanics have been changed: flare will be able to blind a missile only from medium range (about 500 meters), they won't misguide missiles from long range. AA missile itself, when blinded from long range (more than 400 meters), will not go off the course but will significantly lose maneuverability (4 times). It allows pilots to dodge a missile with active maneuver. When blinded from less than 400 meters, a missile will follow flares as before.
[*]AA missiles (R60&AIM-9) now have bigger range and can be guided with maximum zoom.
[*]Double spotting reward bug is fixed.
[*]New ATGM launch sound
[*]New helicopter crash sound
[*]1 second delay between ATGM launches
[*]3rd and 4th gen ATGM maneuverability after 2 sec of flight is reduced
[*]Marker appearance mechanics are changed: markers will appear on a visibility range, hovering helis will be more visible now.
[*]Infantry resupply mechanics are now changed: soldier will be occupying all free seats (they didn't use seats of deployed special troops before), double limit for special troops is removed.
[*]MANPADs on 1st&2nd gens now have less fatal and slower missile. 3rd&4th gens are unchanged
[*]Explosion calculations for AA and MANPAD missiles has been changed: max damage is the same, but will be decreasing to the border of explosion less than before.
[*]Now successful mortars strikes will give an award to the transport heli pilot who deployed them.
[*]Reward for destroying enemy mortars and special badge for destroying mortars in one battle.
[*]Fixed bug with some Throttle devices in advanced control. Now collective won't jump to 0 when throttle is moved into minimum position.
[*]Various small bugfixing
[*]First batch of netcode improvements, should be less network synchronization issues.
[*]ATGM netcode fixes, which should reduce the number of false hits.
[*]EU-2 and US CENTRAL servers have been removed from servers list. Two others that has been left, more powerful ones, are located at the same data-centers.
[*]The Mighty Jingles camouflage has been added to UH-1D.[/list]

[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne — The Release
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/22cdae31f2107c86b021ac5d42c9674c25fc1af4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Hey, Pilots!
This is happening — Heliborne has just been fully released![/h1]

First of all, we want to thank everyone who supported us along the way. We have managed to build a small, but very close and active community. You guys helped us with a lot of things which would be impossible without you, including almost all the localizations and voice acting for the historical campaigns. As for the tiny team of four, it’s vitally important to have those who will give you a hand when needed. And you even did not ask for anything in return. 

THANK YOU! YOU ARE AWESOME, AND WE LOVE ALL OF YOU!

As we announced before, we have a special gift for everyone who bought the game in Early Access. And we wanted it to be so special that we haven’t finished it yet, being insanely busy with the release version of the game itself. However, we believe it’s worth waiting. So thanks again, guys, this time for your patience!

[h1]Next, let’s talk about the game.[/h1] Heliborne has been in the Early Access for a year and a half, since February 2016. Here’s a short list (ok, not so short) of what has been done:
[list][*]20 new helicopters. Now Heliborne features 50 different birds, our plan is to significantly expand the hangar after the release.
[*]3 new maps: Kosovo (25 sq. km), Khost Region (64 sq. km), and a huge and detailed training polygon where you can test helicopters before battles (you will be able to do more there, but let it be our small secret for now). Current map roster includes 6 maps — 5 combat maps and the polygon.
[*]Night map. The first one with lights off is Kosovo. More on the way.
[*]Squadron system. It’s been designed to add more tactics to battles. Very similar to a deck system in card collectible games.
[*]Progression system and Research tree. We designed this research system to be a learning experience, not a grinding one, and plan to keep it this way.
[*]Frontline PvP mode. More tactical evolution of Domination mode with plenty of ground vehicles.
[*]PvE sandbox co-op mode. Also playable in solo.
[*]Two historical campaigns: Easter Offensive in Vietnam (1972) and Operation Magistral in Afghanistan (1987–1988). Co-op play is planned for the post-release period.
[*]Offline mode. For those who can’t or don’t want to play online. Unlocked squadron builder is coming soon.
[*]Customization and cosmetic items. Dozens of helicopter camouflages, helmet paint schemes, and helmet patches.
[*]Private profiles.
[*]Rank & Awards system.
[*]Modular damage system.
[*]Detailed tactical map.
[*]Improved flight model.
[*]Advanced control scheme.
[*]Gamepads/Joysticks/HOTAS support.
[*]New types of deployable special soldiers: SMAW/RPG and mortars. 
[*]Soundtrack.
[*]Steam Trading Cards together with badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons.
[*]New localizations.
[*]A long list of less visible changes we don’t want you to bore with.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/3c8e2386001a73b83748b78fe4a217c0fb7e1af4.jpg[/img]
For those who would like to additionally support further Heliborne development, we’ve added several cosmetic DLC packs with thematic camouflages (4-7 in each). However, it’s totally up to you: players can still unlock plenty of other additional camouflages free of charge, and we’ll be adding more of them!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1eac2ae26dc8d18c8e9ff5dc5f4a150c90e63e20.jpg[/img]
The most important question is “What’s next.” Although the full release is an important milestone for the Team, we are too ambitious to finish the development at this point. We have plenty of ideas, and the release will hopefully give us necessary resources to implement them. With that number of pilots playing Heliborne lately, it’s rather a plan than a hope. 

We want to give you some details about what to expect in upcoming updates:
[list][*]PvE improvements: new objective types like covert infiltration, search and rescue, cargo supply, PvE scenarios like defend the position, support the attack, and others
[*]more PvP game modes
[*]carryable cargo for heavy lift helicopters
[*]new options for troop deployment (including fast-roping)
[*]new types of weapons and equipment (radars, more ATGM specifics, etc.)
[*]naval map, naval gameplay, naval helicopter and naval weapons
[*]AI-helicopter for PvE
[*]gameplay tutorial
[*]co-op mode for historical campaigns
[*]in-battle lobby with a possibility to invite friends
[*]VoIP-chat
[*]a special gift for early supporters
[*]more music to listen to in battles
[*]updated sound effects
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Id0ZiyTAOYA[/list]
Special thanks to [b]The Mighty Jingles[/b] who has made a Heliborne review just before the release. The game has never seen such a huge amount of players online as yesterday. Honestly, this is the best possible present we could get for the release.

Apart from that, we also want to thank all the other YouTubers/streamers. Thanks to them we have been able to spread the word about Heliborne even with zero marketing budget. BaronVonGamez, MagzTV, PhlyDaily, Raptor, TheDevildogGamer, and many others gave us a push when we entered the Early Access, just as The Mighty Jingles did on the full release. Don’t know if we could have made it without their help (probably not).

[h1]Version 0.86 changelog:[/h1]
[list][*]Night version of the Kosovo map. Only PvP at the moment, but PvE version will also be added soon. Be warned: the visibility here is much lower than on its day-time counterpart.
[*]5 new helicopters in the research tree: AH-6, MH-6, Ka-26, Ka-27, and Ka-60.
[*]The first version of historical missions. They are divided into two campaigns, which will be improved and expanded later.
[*]New helicopter camouflages, around 40 variations. Can be unlocked for progression points.
[*]Several cosmetic DLC packs with nearly 40 thematic helicopter camouflages. Purchasable via Steam.
[*]MH-60L/AH-60L has received 4 soldiers.
[*]Romanian IAR-330L has been moved to the Soviet side.
[*]ATGM improvement: a missile loses direction when a player switches to another weapon.
[*]Mortar troops improvement: more powerful mortar shell (close to rockets damage-wise) and increased ammo.
[*]Filters for the list of battles.
[*]Tonkin map: the map borders have been expanded.
[*]"Power shield" on bases against spawn killing has been removed from PvE.
[*]The reward for finishing PvP battles (both with victory and defeat) has been increased significantly.
[*]A reward for completing objectives to the whole team has been added to PvE. The higher is the difficulty, the more points you get.
[*]Ground vehicles on Nguyen map now are more vulnerable to miniguns.
[*]Background in-battle music has been added.
[*]Players limit has been decreased for PvP-mode on two maps: Tonkin — 5v5, Badakhshan — 6v6.
[*]Helicopters' textures have been updated.[/list]

Faithfully yours,
[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Pilots! The date everyone has been waiting for is close. We are excited to announce that Heliborne will be fully released on [i]October 12[/i]!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mUcoiklSiDY
It has been a long road, we’ve had good times, we’ve had bad times. But you guys have been always supporting us along the way. Let us express a deep gratitude to you. Without your support we wouldn’t achieve the point we are currently at. But better to do well than to say well, so every early supporter will receive a special gift from the Team JetCat. 

What changes you can expect in the release version of Heliborne:

notes.title: Heliborne 0.73 — Progression System (pre-release update)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/cee2a16bc49ab20dc7aa9a5b467437dccdbf4b56.jpg[/img]
Greetings Pilots! Heliborne is getting closer to the release, the Date will be announced very soon. Almost everything that we’ve promised to add during the Early Access stage has been implemented already. Just a few things will be left after the update 0.73, like a single player campaign, soundtrack and updated sounds, several new helicopters, and some other changes. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/efb1e774caa0423ab7448acb02b079f80db5b03e.jpg[/img]
The Update 0.73 introduces a new game element, a very important one —  Progression System. From now on most of the helicopters will be locked at the beginning. You’ll need to play and earn progression points to unlock helicopters and new modification.

We’ve been testing the progression system a lot to be both challenging and fun. Although you don’t have everything on a plate from the very start, you should be able to unlock something new literally after every battle. We really hope it will bring more players to battles and make you Heliborne experience more satisfying.

Please let us know what you think about it and how do you find the speed and difficulty of the progression: fast/easy, slow/difficult, or just perfect.

[quote]What about experience points (=military ranks) you have already earned, you would ask? They will be transformed into progression points! It means that those of you who’ve been playing Heliborne recently will receive a certain amount of points in exchange for military rank. You will be able to spend them right away.[/quote]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1eb693a9d2d7da243e3a04b951cacb982e7a6c93.jpg[/img]
Many players asked whether it is possible to play Heliborne without an internet connection. Now it is — the update 0.73 features the Offline Mode! Single player campaign, when released, will be available in Offline Mode as well.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/637250fc8d64319cf9f0664095e5109f8590ef33.jpg[/img]
Apart from that, we’ve introduced first 24 camouflages (more will be added on release), kill assist, new hangar music (thanks to NicerDicer!), in-lobby battle timer, bonuses for finishing battles, and more.

[h1]0.73 Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]progression system
[*]first 24 camouflages added to progression (more on release)
[*]squadron repair bonus: you will get faster repair time with squadron which does not utilize more than half of available points
[*]offline start - you can start the game without an internet connection
[*]ATGM launch warning - you will have a warning now when ATGM is launched in your direction, also there is possibility to have additional info about where is ATGM coming from, depends if it shot from forward, side or back
[*]top ATGM max speed is reduced a bit
[*]now you need soldiers and vehicles inside landing zone give 50% of capture points for top team point bar, instead of 100% given if both are present
[*]ATGM bug where it exploded on launch was fixed
[*]mortar stuck inside landing zone bug fixed
[*]helicopter tilt and strafe when rotating in hover changed - should make less movement
[*]RPG accuracy on ground targets significantly improved
[*]RPG accuracy on air targets reduced
[*]rifleman accuracy reduced
[*]using spotting you can now mark soldiers for friendly vehicles to shoot from bigger distances
[*]using spotting you can now mark soldiers for friendly door gunners to shoot from bigger distances
[*]squadrons now won't be destroyed when helicopter squad prices are changed, but they will be marked as an invalid squadron and you can fix them
[*]Mi-24P main gun and AH-1G Vulcan gun now have recoil, also Mi-24P main gun now does not have forced burst
[*]all guns and bullets were changed according to feedback from new damage system
[*]some rockets were changed according to feedback from module damage system
[*]tail module now takes more damage before being "critted" comparing to other models
[*]AA fire should be a bit more accurate and a bit more powerful according to feedback from module damage system
[*]some reward point values are changed for PvP and Coop
[*]you now will receive a significant reward for a win or defeat in PvP battles, win in Coop battles and first win of the day in any type of battle
[*]rank point criteria are changed, generally, ranks are now harder to obtain than before, but not very hard
[*]in the coop, neutral LZ's should not be suddenly captured by enemies if a player is in close vicinity to it
[*]added point reward for kill assist
[*]stealing "spot" is now impossible if you "spot" enemies which are currently are under "spot" effect from someone else - you will just prolong the spot effect, you need to "spot" enemies which are not spotted atm to get spotting reward
[*]lobby battle UI now shows timer till the end of a battle
[*]heat seeking missiles now have smaller than before (~45% smaller, but still pretty wide, locking sector)
[*]UI changes
[*]new hangar/menu melody - thanks to NicerDicer![/list]

[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.61 — Modular damage system and updated Flight model
notes.content:
Greetings pilots! Update 0.61 is now live. This is a big one weighing in at about 500 MB. Apart from what you will read in patch notes, we've prepared the ground for upcoming updates with even more significant changes. So, what do we have in 0.61, you would ask? 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qQecnSSMsTk
A lot. First of all, we have improved helicopter flight models and have adjusted them to behave more realistically. Overall, the helicopters have become more unique and different from one another. 

Another feature that you’ve all been waiting for is the modular damage system. Helicopters now have five critical modules which have various effects on the flight model when destroyed. For example, when the tail boom is critically damaged, the helicopter will spin out of control temporarily.  Gradual damage to a module will not have any effect on performance, only critical damage.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/a087369cbf5a1101e05893b1a03d1f975fa2ee4a.jpg[/img]

We've also added a tactical map to the TAB menu. This map is much more detailed than mini-map and provides an assortment of information about soldiers, ground vehicles, helicopters (with corresponding player names), and topography. We hope it will give you more opportunities to cooperate with your team.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/0f05ab461d49cb7122c9f0e68606c96d6598bec3.jpg[/img]

Want more? Check the full patch notes:
[list]
[h1]Modular damage system[/h1]
[*]Helicopters now have a modular structure for 5 critical modules: main rotor, engine, tail boom, fuel, and hydraulics. Some helicopters have duplicate modules (e.g. 2 engines or 2 fuel tanks). A helicopter is destroyed when it loses one of the modules or its structural integrity is compromised.
[*]When a module receives critical damage, it stops functioning properly and alters helicopter performance in a manner unique to the damaged module.
[*]A list of the aircraft modules and their statuses are now indicated on a damage panel under the mini-map.
[*]Maximum helicopter repair time (when repaired at base) has been decreased to 30 seconds. This is far less than the repair time after death, which makes returning to base more worthwhile than before.

[h1]Flight model[/h1]
[*]Helicopter flight models have been improved.
[*]Ground effect has been implemented into the flight model. Ground effect in the game is the tendency to gain altitude faster when your helicopter is close to the ground (up to helicopter's blade diameter), upon exiting ground effect, you lose this boost in ascension speed. 
[*]Pitching the nose down in conjunction with losing altitude will now cause notable increase in speed.
[*]Pitching the nose up when flying at decent horizontal speed will now significantly increase altitude but decrease speed.
[*]There have been changes in the flight characteristics of all helicopters. The cruising speed of all helicopters has been slightly decreased to bring it closer to real values while max speed has been increased. Heavy helicopters are now less agile while light helicopters are more agile. Overall, helicopters are more unique and different than before.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[*]Helicopter collision logic has been improved.  There will now be fewer fatal collisions, but more collisions will damage the helicopter over time.
[*]The landing collision logic has been improved. Landing should be both simpler and easier, but you will now receive damage from rough landings.
[*]The squad-building mechanic has been improved. Now every squad has a fixed generation and receives a maximum number of points for its particular generation.
[*]Helicopter loadout mechanics have been improved. Flares (if possible) and door gunners type (if there are several) can now be selected independently from loadout modifications. The UI has changed correspondingly. 
[*]The maximum squad cost for Generation III has been increased from 400 to 480 points.
[*]Costs for all helicopters have been corrected.
[*]Mi-2: first and second armament options have been swapped.
[*]There is now a tactical map in the TAB menu.
[*]There have been changes to mini-map GUI.
[*]The radio menu no longer blocks controls.
[*]Soldiers now stop in front of fatal obstructions.
[*]Helicopter class and loadout modification parameters have been added to the GUI.
[*]Helicopter spawn orientation (South-North direction) has been fixed and now depends on the team's position on the map.
[*]Heat-seeking missiles have received a wider lock-on radius.
[*]Heat-seeking missiles now lock-on faster to hovering targets.
[*]The accuracy of stationary AA guns has been decreased.
[*]MANPADs won't launch a missile on short distance when the missile will most likely overshoot helicopter.
[*]The after-death falling algorithm (after-explosion trajectory) has been changed.
[*]Ground vehicles will now always aim for the center of mass of enemy vehicles.
[*]There have been minor visual changes to various helicopters (prior to introduction of customization).
[*]There have been various minor changes to game maps (a result of working on historical campaigns).
[*]There have been several important bug fixes (doubled points for spotting, wrong penalty for specific cases of friendly fire, etc.).
[*]Thanks to Valery Oldpilot and Daelock, as well as other pilots who give us advice about flight model and point out mistakes.
[*]Thanks to David "Wildcard" for his module damage voice lines.
[*]Thanks to KapukiCram, Erkeo, Adoramus, and Meinpanda for testing new module damage system.
[/list]

[i]P.S. If your game suddenly switched to Russian and you can't switch it back, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/433530/discussions/0/1471969431595755082/]here is the solution[/url].[/i]

[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Good Morning, Vietnam: give your voice to Heliborne
notes.content:
Pilots, after several months of work Heliborne Single-player Historical Campaign is almost ready. One important thing it still lacks is voice-over for radio messages. 

We could have tried to record everything by ourselves. But since Heliborne has an awesome community of talented people around it, we decided to address to you, pilots. Meet the [b]"Good Morning, Vietnam!"[/b] event!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/6d34d7d3db0c7ae579d10d920829b3004d93bfa7.jpg[/img]

[h1]WHAT WE NEED[/h1]
One part of the upcoming single-player is a Vietnam historical campaign with roughly 300 radio messages. We need to voice-over them and are looking for people willing to do it.

[h1]HOW CAN YOU HELP[/h1]
If you want to give your voice to a Heliborne character:
[list]
[*]record following test messages (you can do that with any tools you have, including your smartphones):
[quote]— Papa Bear, this is Alpha-2, requesting reinforcements and resupply, how copy?
— Papa Bear, this is Foxtrot-3, we are under attack. Lots of tanks. Bridge is being overrun, I repeat, bridge is overrun. Heavy casualties. We are holding position south of the bridge. Do you copy?
— This is Badger. We got hit, left wing is on fire! Mayday! Mayday! Mayday![/quote]
[*]send the audio to good.morning.vietnam@jetcatgames.com [u][i]not later than August, 15[/i][/u];
[*]in your email please specify how many radio messages you would like to record (just several/one-two dozens/as many as needed).[/list]

After August, 15th we will send lines for a voice-over with instructions to selected participants.

[h1]REWARDS[/h1]
Although we hope that for most of participants this opportunity itself will be satisfying enough, we will give following rewards to every Heliborne voice actor:
[list][*]one copy of Heliborne,
[*]special cosmetic item,
[*]mention in titles,
[*]access to closed tests.[/list]

[i]Looking forward to your test recordings!
Team JetCat[/i]
