notes.title: Double Drop Rate Weekend
notes.content:
Greetings, Pilots! First things first: we are working on several major updates at the moment. These are mostly new game mechanics for single player and cooperative missions (more activity for soldiers and more interaction with them), new mechanics for interaction with artillery and aviation, changes in squadron building system, a detailed tactical map, and many more. We will soon start binging part of them to the game gradually, the other part will be left for the release version.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/012b3b2f39a8a16d88b9a4ce9dd70f3e82132a6c.jpg[/img]

While those updates are getting ready we prepared a special event. For the whole weekend until July 23rd we will:
1) DOUBLE drop rate of cosmetic items (after finished battle),
2) ADD 8 new helmets and 14 patches to the rotation (exclusively for the weekend!).

Come and get some!

[h1]Team JetCat[/h1]

notes.title: Patch 0.52.1
notes.content:
Greetings pilots! Today's just a small patch with a few fixes and small updates.

[h1][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/433530/announcements/detail/1332352813822003098/]Heliborne 2017: Recap post[/url], if you did not read it[/h1]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]

[*] Fixed several bugs related to the objective and Victory screens in coop play. (thanks for your reports)
[*] Fixed a bug with camera turning upside down in some cases. (thanks for your reports)
[*] Several small changes in certain enemy positions in Nguyen and Badahshan single/coop missions.
[*] The Door gunner description in the armament section now shows the weapon they are using.
[*] Door gunners will now identify and aim at AA positions from a farther distance away from the target. This targeting and engagement distance is farther than the normal targeting and engagement distance for soldiers.
[*] Manpad soldiers no longer have a ~1.5 second period of ignoring flares after acquiring a target.
[*] 5 favorite awards now can be shown in profile (previously it was up to 4)
[*] Password-protected coop games now award points and cosmetic items.
[*] Added ground frag messages in password-protected games.
[*] Showing HUD picture in first person view is now an option you can enable in Settings - General
[*] New settings for camera tilt in third person view in Settings - General
[*] [i][updated, 12 Jul][/i] Changes to first person camera behaviour - you should not see part of the helicopter model while in first person/zoom view anymore
[*] [i][updated, 12 Jul][/i] You will not get spotting award when you destroy yourself targets you just spotted

[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/eb1c4df0d6112be603a4e56b80e383a8af6e55f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Heliborne 2017: Recap (and Version 0.52)
notes.content:
Hey, Pilots! It's time for another update — 0.52. But we also want to use your attention to summarize what we did in the latest updates and what we are going to include in the release version of Heliborne. Let's roll!

[h1]HIGHLIGHTS OF THE LATEST UPDATES[/h1]

[h1]Singleplayer/Cooperative mode[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/b81ece5e1646388730ecc9c0925f83f62acb47e2.jpg[/img][/h1]
Several sandbox-missions with procedurally generated tasks. This mode is available for 1–4 players (max number of players will be increased) on Operation “Nguyen Hue”, Kosovo, The Gulf of Tonkin, and Badakhshan Province game scenarios (the list will be expanded).

[h1]Rank & Awards System[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d7f1e6dbcda5706af13aa78ad684937b9a657e36.jpg[/img][/h1]
We’ve implemented to Heliborne private players profiles and rank & awards system. Every effective action in battle lead to progression within rank ladder. Combat merits are awarded with medals and ribbons. Selected awards may be put to the profile, its public part is visible to other players.
This is the first big step towards progression system and rating system with leaderboards. 

[h1]Cosmetic items[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/7352b7aa192050f8dd7e95635f4b3829ccd8bc67.jpg[/img][/h1]
Helmets and patches. They are shown in player profiles and act as avatars. Helmets and patches can randomly drop after the battle, or for participating at in-game events.

[h1]Firing range map[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/51069ee7dc98f981013a638f95680919f2fca147.jpg[/img][/h1]
Highly and precisely detailed map of real military aviation polygon — 344th Tactical Deployment Center in Torzhok. It was modelled according to satellite data, photos and videos.
You can start practice flight straight from the hangar or squadrons menu. Hangar is a part of polygon map, so the flight would start almost immediately and from the same location.
Training mission is in the development, and would take place on the same map. We would continue improving the map, adding more training possibilities and even special game mode.

[h1]Apart from that we added:[/h1]
[list][*]New helicopters, including MD-500, Ka-226, HH-53.[/*][*]Gamepad/joystick/HOTAS support. Popular devices received ready-to-go control configurations, but you can connect literally any device (up to 4 simultaneously).  [/*][*]Advanced control scheme. For those who want to receive highest possible control under helicopter.[/*][*]Steam Trading Cards. Six cards featuring legendary helicopters. [/*][*]Badges, profile backgrounds, emoticons. Collect trading cards, create badges and get Heliborne emoticons together with backgrounds to customize your Steam profile.[/*][*]New localizations. Currently Heliborne supports English, Russian, German, French, Polish, Portuguese-Brazil, and Danish languages.[/*][/list]


[h1]PLANS FOR RELEASE[/h1]
Part of them will be implemented within Early Access, the other part — in release version of the game.

[h1]Historical campaigns[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/de6b2332b008cd8e2bccea0620e9a483bd39d5d6.jpg[/img][/h1]
Release version of the game will include two singleplayer historical campaigns: Easter Offensive in Vietnam (1972) and Operation Magistral in Afghanistan (1987–1988). They will feature some unique in-game mechanics we’ve prepared especially for them.

[h1]Career with tech tree[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/7b3ec1018eac4f629a1116415a2d9a30c43624be.jpg[/img][/h1]
Heliborne is going to get progression system with tech tree, divided by different helicopter producers. Players would need to unlock new helicopters using Experience Points earned in battles. Main goal is to gradually introduce player to the game and its mechanics and to motivate players to give different helicopters a try. But do not worry — progression will be pretty fast and definitely not grind F2P style shaped.
[u][b]ATTENTION![/b][/u] When progression system is introduced, players will be rewarded with certain amount of Experience Points. This amount depends on a rank: the higher you have, the more points you will receive.

[h1]Further improvements of Singleplayer/Cooperative mode[/h1]
We actively work to improve the sandbox mode. As it advances, new types of objectives (e.g. medevac missions), new types of enemies, ability to choose intensity of a battle, and even sandbox-campaigns will be implemented. 
Moreover, singleplayer missions will be playable in Offline Mode, without network connection! 

[h1]Heliborne will also feature:[/h1]
[list][*]Experimental Night Mode. Night version of one of the maps is almost ready! 
[*]Multiplayer mode improvements.
[*]Flight model improvements.
[*]Modular damage system.
[*]New helicopters.
[*]Detailed tactical map.
[*]Transport of external load and fast-roping for soldiers.
[*]Steam Workshop support. Selected user-created content will be added to the game if approved by Team JetCat.
[*]Tutorials. Gameplay tutorial missions on the Firing range map.
[*]In-game VoIP-chat (based on Discord SDK).
[*][i]Unique gifts to everyone who has supported us during Early Access![/i][/list]


[h1]HELIBORNE 0.52 CHANGELOG:[/h1]
[list]

[*] 2 new sandbox missions on maps of generation 1 and generation 3.
[*] Several new types of sandbox objectives.
[*] Several logic and positioning improvements for sandbox missions.
[*] 2 new types of enemy infantry for sandbox missions have been added.
[*] The UH-60L helicopter has been split into 2 separate helicopter models - MH-60L and UH-60A. The first model, the MH-60L, is an armed version with 4 armament variants without troop-carrying capability. This moel starts with the DAP model, which is a previously non-existent version, followed by 3 AH-60L variants we already had. This model has been given forward facing miniguns for all armament options. The second model is a pure transport UH-60A with 3 door gunner armament options.
[*] Mi-8MTV has been given an additional door gunner in the back part of the cargo hold. New first armament option is now armed only with 2 rocket launchers and cockpit gun. Third armament option has two automatic grenade launchers instead of 2 rocket pods.
[*] Both of the grenade launchers, 30mm one for RU side and 40mm one for US side have been changed: ammo flight trajectory is now shallower and the weapon is easier to aim and operate.
[*] UH-1Y has been given an additional armament option with 2 rocket pods on each side.
[*] MH-60S now has addtional forward pointing miniguns for all armament options. There is also an additional armament option with 2 rocket pods on each side.
[*] Added a door gunner on the Mi-8T.
[*] Mi-8AMTSH has been given an additional rear door gunner. And two new armament options - first with only 2 gunpods and fourth heavily armed option. Also AMTSH gunner from 2nd to 4th armament options are 12.7mm machinegunners now.
[*] Squadron prices for all helicopters mentioned above rescaled, some changes to other helicopter prices.
[*] Heat seeker missile locking time parameters and locking sector parameters have been rescaled a bit, it should take less time to aquire a lock for both smaller and larger missiles.
[*] Fixed a bug with the frontline game mode where you could not win despite your armor capturing enemy stronghold.
[*] Fixed a bug in the advanced control scheme related to inability to use mouse to look around.
[*] Added setting to change mouse role in advanced control scheme.
[*] Added a setting to enable/disable helicopter names near helicopter type icons in combat HUD.
[*] Several helicopter texture fixes have been applied.

[/list]
[h1][i]Team JetCat[/i][/h1]

[h1]Version 0.51.1[/h1]
[list]
[*] Several logic problems and bugs have been fixed in single player and coop sandbox missions. The hold LZ and stop attack mission will fail if you lose LZ to enemy control before timer expires. The support convoy mission is failed as soon as you lose all vehicles you were supposed to support. The stop convoy mission is failed if the convoy reaches its destination. [*] AH-64A, Mi-28, Mi-28N all have been given 1 additional armament option. We are working on several new armament options for different helicopters, these options will be rolled out over the coming weeks.
 
[*] A lot of price changes for helicopters in Generation 1. These changes probably will not affect your Generation 1 squadrons, but could very much affect your mixed Gen1-2 squadrons
 
[*] There have been slight price changes for several helicopters, (mainly those armament options which were just added)notable changes: AH-1G 2nd and 3rd armament price has been raised slightly. The Mi-8T-TV price for 3 and 4th armament has been slightly lowered.
 
[*] Slight polishing of flight parameters for several helicopters - most notable is HH-53 which will not be as fast as before, (still will be pretty fast, but on par with other transports), HH-53 flight acceleration is more reliant on controlling nose pitch.

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale and an update! Heliborne version 0.51
notes.content:
[h1]New Trailer![/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XlSMeCNKhgQ

[h1] Steam Summer Sale and Patch![/h1]
We've got news pilots! Not only are we pushing out a new patch for Heliborne that is adding new features to SP/COOP, fixes and updates, we're also joining in the steam summer sale fun! 

What does this mean? Well, put simply, it means that Heliborne will be 35% off during the sale!

[h1]Heliborne Version 0.51 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Singleplayer sandbox difficulty settings have been updated slightly. A new “Very Hard” mode has been added.
[*]Sandbox settings - amount of concurrent objectives can be set, from 1 up to 6.
[*]Sandbox settings - amount of total objectives to win can be set, from 5 till full battle win.
[*]Sandbox settings - hardcore mode has been added. In this mode there are much fewer visual assists and aides. You are unable to see where enemy units are or where your troops are. Several HUD components are reduced or disabled outright.
[*]Sandbox missions have had several improvements in task logic, we will continue to work on more types of tasks and sandbox scenarios and will be adding them in next several weeks.
[*]Sandbox enemy infantry is updated.
[*]Sandbox task UI improved.
[*]5 new language translations have been added - polish, german, french, portuguese (fully translated, not like before) and danish (will be updated)
[*]ACH-47 door gunners all have .50 cals now.
[*]HH-53 landing triggers slightly adjusted to further prevent crash on landing.
[*]Aerodrome map visual changes - rotating radar, skidmarks, detail quality to prevent micro-freezes.
[*]AH-1G, OH-6, Scout AH Mk 1 and UH-1D visual update to rocket launcher blocks.
[*]Mi-24A new armament variant called Mi-24B with YakB-12.7 gun.
[*]AH-1G new armament variant with 4 rocket launchers.
[*]Fixed problem with team points in multiplayer frontline mode.
[*]Frontline experimental mode has been removed, several parts of that mode have been rolled into the regular frontline mode.
[*]We are adding additional armament for several helicopters, in this patch the Ka-50 and Ka-52 have been given additional armament types.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/eb1c4df0d6112be603a4e56b80e383a8af6e55f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Heliborne version 0.5 - PVE is finally here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/3b88bba52895dfacbf299720bc4c43464a656de2.jpg[/img]

Pilots! It's finally here! The ability for you to play Heliborne in Single-Player and CO-OP in pure PVE has finally arrived! It's taken us a long time to get here and for that, we're sorry, but we think this first step in to SP/COOP is a good one and we hope you agree.

We've also added the ability to test and fly any helicopter in the game from the squadron tab or the hangar tab. This will take you to the new training map that will allow you the chance to experiment with all of our helos before heading in to MP-PVP.

We're pretty proud of this update, and we hope you are as well!
-Rayne
Team JetCat

[b]Version 0.5[/b]
[list]
[*]Two new singleplayer/cooperative sandbox missions have been added. Right now both of these missions are based on the frontline scenario and have up to 9 different types of tasks that can be issued while playing. We are very much looking for feedback with these missions and we are planning to add new types of tasks in next several weeks. (Ex: rescue and evacuation, infiltration, covert action, etc). Also we want to add one or two new types of scenarios for sandbox missions - for example counter-insurgency scenario and attack scenario. But that depends on your feedback and on how it aligns with our release plans (we are not currently planning to add all of our sandbox singleplayer content before release)[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9299459090b43d733e5dc9411cc7e42370f2f16d.png[/img]

[*]Training flight mode added - You can try out helicopters from the Hangar tab, and the squadron tab, without joining a battle. The Minimap will show you the location of the shooting range. This ranges has some targets, and is a “free fire” area.

[*]The Ka-226 russian light multirole helicopter has been added, and has been placed in recon the role at tier 4. This helicopter does not have any armament outside artillery aim, however, it does have door gunners which work only when there are at least 2 soldiers on board[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/2ce59d8458bb547353952412b486a28e5b88a8ee.png[/img]

[*]The HH-53 US heavy transport has been added to tiers 2, 3, and 4. The HH-53 Does not have any armament besides door gunners, which come in 2 armament variants - miniguns and .50 cal’s[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/99e42d4901977f76e5102c4ac3a14bab3354bf4b.jpg[/img]

[*]The ACH-47 has been made into a gunship. The “Guns A Go Go” version of the helicopter is intended to clear and secure Landing Zones, the amount of troopers inside has been lowered to 10 men and 2 additional door gunners have been added.

[*]The AH-1J has been moved to generation 3, squadron prices have changed for this helicopter

[*]Squadron prices slightly (no big changes) adjusted for 10-15 helicopter variants (mostly intermediate variants to make them more useful)

[*]Several flight parameters have been changed or updated, this mostly affects light helicopters, making them more agile and responsive.

[*]The 20mm gun on H-34, ACH-47, IAR 330L and UH-1Y split into the M24 and GIAT M621 variants, each with different characteristics.

[*]The NS-23KM (Mi-2 gun) has been given better explosive rounds.

[*]All 30mm and 20mm explosive rounds have had their area of effect slightly rescaled to make more sense.

[*]The GSH-2-30K has been given a burst cooldown if more than 50 rounds are fired repeatedly.

[*]Look Around (right mouse button by default) mechanics have changed.When pressing the look around mode button (default right mouse button) the players helicopter no longer maintains the last ordered course. Instead, the helicopter will maintain a course that will be between current and last ordered course. Practically this means that to circle around some positions, you now simply need to press Look Around for a few moments every several seconds. This was done to improve circling abilities and door gunner handling

[*]You can now make the Look Around function work as a toggle, rather then “while button is pressed”, go to Settings - General - Look Around Toggle

[*]When door gunners are selected they switch to manual control mode automatically (you can switch them back to Auto with Change mode button, F by default), when deselected they switch back to to auto control mode.

[*]All Air-to-Air missile blast damage (manpad included) now goes from 100% in center to 50% on the edge (before that it was 0% on the edge). This means that bigger helicopters will take as much damage as smaller helicopters

[*]The R-60 and AIM-9 missiles have had their aiming time increased by 50%

[*]Fixed a bug when your own ATGM or heat seeker missile could hit you on launch, also ATGMs and heat seeker missiles now start with current helicopter speed.

[*]AA missile locking time now include additional time for helicopter sizes (the smaller your helicopter is - the longer it takes to lock onto it) and additional time if the target is flying close to the ground. The closer the target is to the  ground - the longer it takes to lock on, this starts from 45 meters of radar indicated height above the ground.

[*]Anti-aliasing has been added back to graphic preferences.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/eb1c4df0d6112be603a4e56b80e383a8af6e55f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Heliborne Version 0.48.0 (Updated with 0.48.1)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/8eeb3ac49d8ded9149a7d9c26f703c4597941e38.png[/img]

Greetings pilots! Time for another Patch. Today we are pushing out version 0.48 with a new experimental game mode, some quality of life changes, and several balance and gameplay tweaks. Take a look!
-Rayne

[h1]Frontlines Experimental[/h1]
A new Experimental Frontline game mode has been added for the following 3 maps - Nguyen, Khost, and Kosovo. This experimental mode requires capturing Landing Zones to 100% and reinforcing the LZ with vehicles before it can spawn attack convoys. 100% captured and reinforced LZ’s now spawn attack convoys faster than in the normal frontlines mode and also provide repair and resupply to any helicopter landed in the LZ’s area of influence.

[h1]Notes[/h1]
[list]
 [*]RPG soldier cost is down to 5 points
 [*]MANPAD cost is up to 15 points
 [*]MANPAD soldiers are now able to launch 3 missiles, up from 2
 [*]All MANPAD-launched missiles now have a misfire chance of 40% on  [*]Generation 1, 30% on Generation 2, 20% on Generation 3, 10% on Generation 4
 [*]All air launched IR missiles now have similar misfire chance of 20%/15%/10%/5% per Generation 1/2/3/4
 [*]IRCM miss chances are increased to 60% for missiles on distances greater then 250 meters and 82% on 250 meters and less
 [*]Several changes to helicopter costs for squadrons have been made. The top armament variant costs are the same, baring the AH-1J Sidewinder variant - its cost has been increased. Most of the changes have been made to intermediate variants so they better represent actual armament and allow for more options when choosing non-top tier helicopters for your squadrons.
 [*]Hovering over your rank in top-left corner of main menu now shows your progress to next rank.
 [*]Awards tab in Career now shows all possible awards, not only ones you have at the moment
 [*]Several award criterias have been adjusted so they are easier to get. Mostly the awards that have seen no player earn, despite being designed for players to earn regularly.
 [*]Points received for air kills are now related to the weapon type used: guns award the most points, rockets award less, and missiles (both ATGM and IR) award the least of all weapon systems.
 [*]Awards given for air to air kills (the Air combat master series) now give additional points upon being earned. As normal, the points for the awards themselves assist with rank progression. 
 [*]Awards for air kills now require more kills (15 20 30)
 [*]All officer rank requirements have been increased by 30%.
 [*]Several helicopter’s landing collider modules have been fixed to prevent sudden explosion upon landing.
 [*]Modern high-caliber rockets (130mm S-13 and 127mm Zuni) damage output has been increased. Now they can destroy light armored vehicle with one direct hit
 [*]“V-sync for hangar” option has been added to Graphic settings
 [*]Several helicopter’s flight parameters have been adjusted (Mi-2 and Ka-25 made slightly more agile, AH-1Z loses more altitude when in a dive)
 [*]Spotting targets with recon helicopter now marks them for 50 seconds
[/list]


[h1]0.48.1[/h1]
[list]
[*]Resupply on Landing Zones in Experimental mode now does not work on IR missiles
[*]Flares now bounce from the ground and other hard surfaces
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/6ad10e520c074c6243ffd4aae1db5a72972a9425.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1e6fbb3e9f91e3c166a094134f51653de756a7c4.png[/img]

 [*]Awards given for air to air kills (the Air combat master series) now give additional points upon being earned. As normal, the points for the awards themselves assist with rank progression. 
 [*]Awards for air kills now require more kills (15 20 30)
 [*]All officer rank requirements have been increased by 30%.
 [*]Several helicopter’s landing collider modules have been fixed to prevent sudden explosion upon landing.
 [*]Modern high-caliber rockets (130mm S-13 and 127mm Zuni) damage output has been increased. Now they can destroy light armored vehicle with one direct hit
 [*]“V-sync for hangar” option has been added to Graphic settings
 [*]Several helicopter’s flight parameters have been adjusted (Mi-2 and Ka-25 made slightly more agile, AH-1Z loses more altitude when in a dive)
 [*]Spotting targets with recon helicopter now marks them for 50 seconds
[/list]


[h1]0.48.1[/h1]
[list]
[*]Resupply on Landing Zones in Experimental mode now does not work on IR missiles
[*]Flares now bounce from the ground and other hard surfaces
[/list]

notes.title: 0.47.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/8eeb3ac49d8ded9149a7d9c26f703c4597941e38.png[/img]


Greetings pilots! Just a quick update here for you regarding 0.47.1. We noticed a few issues in 0.47 and as such we're putting out this quick fix to change a few things. Notes are below,

- AA positions and AA vehicle damage output has been nerfed: they are less precise than in 0.47 version and take more time to aim But still are much better than in 0.46.1 version
- MANPAD operational procedure changed: their range changed from 600 meters distance to 400m min and 1200m max distance, but targeting on distances bigger than 400m now depends on both helicopter actual altitude above the ground and helicopter size. So if you don't want MANPAD’s to shoot at you from longer distances stay closer to the ground.
- MANPAD blind by IRCM lowered from 10 to 7 seconds
- Helicopter spotting profiles have been slightly decreased for all helicopters. (that means if you fly low you can get closer to the AA before they spot you)
- Helicopter spotting profile is now increased if helicopter is static for several seconds - so you’ll be spotted from longer distances if you are hovering are greater altitudes.
- Convoy spawn logic slightly adjusted - when multiple landing zones attack another zone they won't produce multiple convoys to attack, only one after another
- Rank requirements for officer ranks (ensign and upwards) slightly adjusted, they cost more than previous.
- Test medal image changed
- Negative rewards introduced. Do not kill friendly units, you’ll get negative rewards and will be banned from game room if you are doing it a lot.
- Reward for capturing Landing Zone now depends on amount of players in the battle, the more the players present the larger the reward.

notes.title: Heliborne version 0.47 "Foundation" is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/8eeb3ac49d8ded9149a7d9c26f703c4597941e38.png[/img]


Greetings Pilots! It's been a while, and I do apologize for that, but we think it will have been worth the wait. With this update, we finally have the foundations in place for the sprint to release. With a new awards system, the backbone for future SP and CO-OP content, major backend changes and code updates, a lot of fixes and more. 

[h1] Server Changes [/h1]
Pilots, just a quick note that Heliborne is operating using a new Data Layer with this update. Unfortunately this has also caused several issues with some of our Azure based servers. What this means, is that we are prepairing a new server pack for you to play on, that should help with performance and connection issues.

However, there's one major change here, and that revolves around us having to shut down our current SEA server as we look for a better alternative for our SEA players. We're hoping the new data layer and updates to the server backend will give our SEA players a good experience on the EU and US servers until we can get a replacement SEA server operational. Again, this is not a permanent change.

We apologize for the inconvenience. -Rayne

[h1]New Aircraft[/h1]
*The MD-500 has been added to the vehicle lineup. This Helicopter has been placed at Tiers 2 and 3.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9e48e49bce6640c9546226e9e95cd169c435ed0f.jpg[/img]


[h1]New Features[/h1]
- Personal player profiles have been added. These profiles are shown upon player kill, as well as in the new Career tab.
- Rewards for effective actions in combat have been added. There are a total of 28 awards in this update.
- Rank progression has been added and is based on rewards gained.
- Player awards can be placed in a player's profile.
- The first batch of steam cosmetic items has been added, this includes a few helmets and patches.
- Helmets can be shown in a player's profile.
- Cosmetic items are awarded at the end of the match.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/167a69650a70fac9e2a50616c074188c99d7ba13.png[/img]


[h1]Bug Fixes and Changes[/h1]
- Added keybind to trigger gun reload manually
- A special sound when gun reload is finished has been added
- Fixed a crucial bug in gun reloading, encounters with enemy guns may become deadlier with this patch
- Fixed precision bug in stationary and moving ground AA guns - they should become much more accurate now.
- Ground AA time before maximum precision is increased and damage output is lowered - to compensate giant increase in AA gun precision
- "enemy lock" has been added, a locked enemy is marked with ">" "<" symbols and his nickname is always shown, a lock looks like this - "> enemy name <"
- Enemy lock is done automatically when targetting enemy in sight
- Keybind to trigger a manual enemy lock has been added and is toggleable (by default - E, works only in flight)
- Locking on an enemy now assists with gun shooting - this is nothing heavy, just a small aim assist that help with adjusting aim distance to that enemy - it should be easier to shoot at locked enemies than an enemy without lock.
- All ATGM's angle speed is decreased
- ATGM additional vision distance is now slightly smaller
- Taking hits while in ATGM aiming mode now "shakes" helicopter
- Mortar team ammo increased to 30 rounds
- Recon helicopter "spot" ability is now shown in the UI
- "spot" ability now spots targets for longer period of time
- "spot" ability now informs all friendlies on the map
- "spot" ability now puts spotted enemy soldiers on the minimap for a 30 minute period (this allows recon helicopters to "paint" enemy manpad positions for friendlies, for example)
- The Recon helicopter's detect ability has had its range increased in distance
- Flares now blind manpads for a short period of time (~10 seconds)
- RPG soldiers now have 4 rocket launches 
- RPG soldiers now shoot at enemy helicopters inside a larger range zone (~220m) and have had their accuracy increased
- Door gunners default operation mode is now set to AUTO 
- Camera zoom is now saved between game sessions
- All spawn positions now have a defensive "force field" around them, approximately 300 meters in radius, you are safe from enemy damage inside these areas.
- Several small fixes in armament option text layout
- Updated camera for advanced control scheme
- Snap look left / look right actions for advanced control scheme
- Looking around in advanced control scheme is now possible with mouse
- AH-1Z and AH-1S turret gun damage output is increased
- All agile helicopters have had their roll increased during high speed turns
- Filters for nations and generations added on Hangar and Squadrons screens
- Fixed squad price calculation problem when changing current squad generation
- Fixed water visuals on khost map
- Mortar unit maximum accuracy increased by 30%

notes.title: Heliborne Version 0.46.1 "Higher Elevation" is Now Live.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/8eeb3ac49d8ded9149a7d9c26f703c4597941e38.png[/img]

Greetings pilots! It's been a wait,and for that, we'd like to apologize. However, I'd like to think the wait was well worth it. Welcome to version 0.46.1!

[h1]Controls[/h1]
-Support for all major gamepads has been added. This includes PS4, XBOX One and Steam Gamepads. Settings can be changed via new settings tab.

-Support for Joysticks and HOTAS set ups has been added. Kebybinding and calibration settings can be accessed via a new settings tab.

[b]Pilots, please keep in mind this is a first pass for these new controls and there may be issues. Also, default keybinds may be wrong. Please give us feedback.[/b]

[b]Please note that custom settings will be discarded and you will need to setup your own custom controls again.[/b]

-Added new control scheme. There is now a  simple and advanced mode.

[h1]UI[/h1]
-Control UI has been reworked.
-Settings UI while in the hangar has been reworked.
-A slider to control hangar music has been added

[h1]Gameplay and Balance[/h1]
-Added ballistics pass to all weapons. Bullets now loose height and velocity over distance.
-Travel distance for larger caliber weapon has been increased.
-Several Weapon sounds have been changed
-All weapons now have a maximum amount of ammunition as well as a reload timer after all ammunition has been spent.
-The 2A42 weapon system is now 9 rounds per second instead of 18. Overall damage output is roughly the same.
-GSh-2-30K weapon system is now firing at 30 rounds per second.
-Gun aim has been reworked.
-"Crosshair Jumping" has been fixed.
-Ground vehicles now have front, side, back, and top armor values. Each vehicle has its own independent parameters. Tanks are now very heavily armored compared to IFV's and APC's.
-All bullets now have armor penetration values based on caliber.

[b]As a result of the above changes, it is now no longer possible to damage a tank with 7.62 or 12.7mm weapon systems. Causing damage from the sides, rear, or top is now possible with larger caliber weapons but the damage will still be reduced due to heavy armor.[/b]

-AA Gun precision has been slightly increased
-Helicopters with optical systems now have a turret "precision mode" - This is toggalable from cockpit view with Keybind "F" by default.
-Current weapon is now shown on HUD.
-Current and Maximum zoom for cockpit view and ATGM view is now shown on HUD.
-Minor changes in flight parameters for almost all helicopters.
-Changes in audio volume and sound effects when in cockpit modes.

[b][h1]Heliborne is now 64bit enabled![/h1][/b]
Steam will automatically download the 64bit version of Heliborne. This should happen with all future updates.

Thanks pilots! We hope you enjoy this update! -Rayne
Team JetCat

notes.title: Heliborne Version 0.46 "Elevation"
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/e34cb93a36c503784c8cd66af98df7c48f45eb0c.png[/img]

Greetings pilots! It's time to discuss the upcoming version update. Heliborne version 0.46, which we're calling "Elevation" as we truly believe we are elevating the game to a new level. Though, this update also provides something of a foundation for future progress and updates as we move forward toward release. This article will go over all the major changes as well as list the preliminary patch notes for you. So, let's get started as usual shall we?


[h1]Unity Version 5.5.X[/h1]
The first big thing of note is our move from Unity 4.X to Unity 5.X. Specifically, we are now on Unity version 5.5.0f3. Your first question no doubt is, "Why does this matter?" The answer to that is simply, it just does. It matters a lot. However the much longer winded explanation follows with the help of Unity's own version 5 website. I'll post a link here: https://unity3d.com/unity/whats-new/unity-5.0

For those not wanting to head to the link, here's Unity's own words for why version 5.0 is better.

[list]
[*]The Physically-based Standard Shader to make your materials look consistent in any lighting environment, cross platform.
[*]Real-time Global Illumination, built on Geomerics Enlighten technology.
[*]The Audio Mixer, to massively improve audio in your game.
[*]HDR Reflection Probes to enhance visual fidelity.
[*]PhysX 3.3 to bring massive performance improvements to 3D physics.
[*]Major updates to the animation system.
[*]WebGL preview.
[/list]

The above being just the start, or the tip of the iceberg so to speak. Here's a nice Unity version 5.0 Trailer for you to watch as well, which should help show off "Some" of the goodness.

*As a note, I think this trailer is amazing.*

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJ6Mkx1KEns

Moving on!

[h1]The new Stuff[/h1]
A great deal has changed when you log in to the game now. Firstly, we have an entirely new Main Scene and Squadron Construction update for you to enjoy. This means a brand new map built entirely for the main hangar and squadron view scenes. One that you'll be able to fly on soon. As to what these new scenes and UI updates look like, here's a quick video showing them off,

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H0CgqmsVCrw

As you can see, the Squadron Overview and construction system has been entirely remade. We're hoping this version is far more intuitive to use. The hangar scene has been redone as well. All of this, as I said, built on a brand new map that we'll be using for training missions in the future and maybe something else special you've all been asking for? :)

[h1]The Prelim Patch Notes[/h1]
Here's a quick look at the preliminary patch notes for Version 0.46,
[list]
[*]Moved the project from Unity Version 4.x to Unity Version 5.x. This means a lot of behind the scenes changes that will yield a great deal in the future for Heliborne as a whole.
[*]Major changes to internal map building scheme. This has changed and optimized map workflow for creation and fix implementation.
[*]Changes and updates to shaders and visual effects system.
[*]New Hangar scene introduced.
[*]New Main Scene and Squadron Overview
[*]Squadron Constructor rework
[*]UI Rework
[*]Added new Afghanistan, Khost province, map. This map is for Tier 3.
[*]Increased bullet lifetime by 30%
[*]Decreased unguided rocket drop height after initial engine burst.
[/list]

That's it for this one folks, stay tuned for more! We've got a lot more coming.
-Rayne
Team JetCat
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1e6fbb3e9f91e3c166a094134f51653de756a7c4.png[/img]

notes.title: The future is bright.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/e34cb93a36c503784c8cd66af98df7c48f45eb0c.png[/img]

Greetings Pilots! It's been a while since we last updated you with our plans and for that, I apologize. However, I personally think the wait might be worth it as we've a lot planned and a lot that's being worked on. So, let's get started taking a look at the future of Heliborne shall we?

[h1]The Current Plan[/h1]
First, you can expect a small bug fixing patch coming in the next few days. This patch will see some new audio for our quick messages, updates to door gunners and IR missiles and updates to manpads and vehicles. We'll get the patch ntoes out to you guys before the patch goes live as normal.

[h1]"Hangar Bay"[/h1]
First things first, our Hangar UI and UI in general needed some work. We can admit that it wasn't great and so, we rebuilt it from the ground up. We've been teasing this for some time, but today, you're getting the first screenshots of the new UI system in-game and what is coming in the "Hangar Bay" update.

First, the newly updated Main Screen, or Squadron View. In this screen you are presented with a view of your entire squadron. As well as the ability to Edit and Delete the current squadron, soldiers in your squadron, the new filter down at the bottomw right hand of the screen, the join battle button and lastly your new squadron listing down at the bottom of the screen. There will be a video going up before the patch comes out showcasing how this all works, so stay tuned!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/VtP8tpg.jpg[/img]

Next, the single Helo Hangar scen and UI has been updated as well. In this screen, we've changed how the helos are presented to you and resituated the UI a little to better display information. There will be updates to this in the future.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/gYfIo21.jpg[/img]

We'll go over what's coming in the stats tracking section of this update in an upcoming article. So, stay tuned for that!

[h1]"Firepower"[/h1]
The Update after the new UI is tentitavely known as Firepower. In this update we are rebuilding the ballsitics system in the game. This means the ability to have weapon convergence, fire-modes, ballistic drop, etc. As well as updates  to targeting of these weapon systems. I'll have more to talk about this in a seperate update as well.

[h1]"The Power of Flight"[/h1]
The Power of Flight update will see a large list of changes to flight dynamics and the flight model. This means things like weight affecting flight, new handling updates, the ability to have new control systems, etc.  We hope to be able to showcase this update in testing before the end of the year, so stay tuned for more on this.

[h1]"Progress"[/h1]
Lastly, the Progress update. I can't talk to much about this, but what I can say is that in this update, you'll finally have a reason to play more than a few hours a day. :)

[h1]Some other bits and pieces[/h1]
So, what about stuff in between that? Well, for starters our new Afghanistan map is almost finished and should be in soon!

Here's a quick screenshot for you tactical types out there curious how the map flow works,
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JJxXH0d.jpg[/img]

Last but not least, you have a new helo coming soon. So, let me just leave this here for ya,
[img]http://i.imgur.com/GhcFZgN.jpg[/img]

-Rayne
Team JetCat 


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1e6fbb3e9f91e3c166a094134f51653de756a7c4.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.45.2 — door gunners!
notes.content:
Hey pilots! The update 0.45.2 is live! 

- added door gunners on helicopters:
Mi-8TV, Mi-8MTV, Mi-8AMTSH, Ka-25, H-21, H-34, UH-1D, UH-1Y, ACH-47, IAR-330L
- door gunners operate in 3 modes: pilot (manual control by default), hold (do not shoot) and auto (automatically shoot at soldiers and AA positions in close proximity to helicopter). To switch between operation modes enable weapon number 7 and use F key to cycle to next mode
- changed mortars behaviour - now they can shoot 5 times in quick succession, then reload for 5-6 second and be able to shoot 5 times again
- changed mortar explosion effect on soldiers and AA positions - explosion range is increased, damage is relative to distance from center of explosion
- changed both mortar and rocket explosion effect on vehicles - you need to hit really close to the vehicle in order to damage it, full effect comes only with direct hit
- added 2 more spectating modes to spectator
- ATGM damage increased
- tank HP on Kosovo map is increased (its the same as tank HP on Nguyen map now, was lower before)
- added info about radio shortcuts to F1 help menu
- decreased time needed for AA to reach maximum accuracy

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1e6fbb3e9f91e3c166a094134f51653de756a7c4.png[/img]

notes.title: Heliborne 0.45 "Synergy" Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/e34cb93a36c503784c8cd66af98df7c48f45eb0c.png[/img]

[h1]1. Mortar Troops[/h1]
- 2 man mortar squad with 20 mines
- costs 8 points per squad
- can be deployed anywhere on the map
- has firing range of 300 - 3000 meters, radio contact range of 5000 meters
- has proper mine travel time - do not expect mines to be fast
- receives targetting from any recon helicopter with "Mortar Observer"
- one recon helicopter can control up to 6 mortar teams at once

[h1]2. AA changes[/h1]
- all AA now significantly more accurate
- it tries to predict your flying pattern
- the more you are in its sights - the more accurate it becomes, it takes ~20 seconds to reach maximum accuracy
- spotting formula introduced: the smaller your helicopter is and the lower you fly - the harder it is for AA to spot you
- with the new spotting formula you can sneak around AA positions on lower altitudes, but if you are flying high - it will spot you much earlier
- it has morale now - shooting at AA now makes it shoot less accurate and less frequently

[h1]3. Special soldiers[/h1]
- now you can direct your special soldiers upon landing, just point where you want them to run, before deploying them
- directed deployment radius is 50 meters
- MANPAD's behaviour changed: from now they will include spottinng formula in target search, they wont shoot at you on sight, but wait small amount of time till you move closer to them
- MANPAD missile speed increased
- MANPAD targetting range increased by 100 meters
- you can see your soldiers positions on minimap from now on (look for small orange dots)

[h1]4. Enemy spotting[/h1]
- from now on helicopters of different classes will spot enemies on different distances: recon helicopters can spot enemies from further away then attack helicopters and transport helicopters
- to spot vehicles or AA positions you need line of sight now
- recon helicopters are able to share spotted targets with their team using radio spotted message - binded to 'V' by default

[h1]5. Radio messages[/h1]
- added 7 basic radio messages
- you can send them via F2-F8 shortcuts
- or via '`' menu and 1-7 afterwards

[h1]6. Spectator mode[/h1]
- you can choose to spectate your teammates when you lost or changing your helicopter

[h1]7. Other changes[/h1]
- decreased price of first Ka-52 variant and increased price of second and third variant
- friendly helicopters marked by type above them in combat, triangle is recon, rombus is attack and square is transport
- changed several ammo hit effects
- changed armor hit effect for most higher-caliber guns
- added ricochet effect for all bullets
- some visual fixes on Nguyen map

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1e6fbb3e9f91e3c166a094134f51653de756a7c4.png[/img]

Greetings pilots! Time for another quick update. Firstly, if you were wondering about 0.44.8, it was a small bug fixing updated that focused on fixing vehicle issues on Nguyen Hue.

[h1][b]0.44.9 Update Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Older generations of ATGM missiles now have the correct version of their aimsight. This change affects the following ATGM's on the Mi-1, Mi-2, Mi-4, Mi-8TV, Ka-15, OH-13, UH-1B, AH Mk. 1, OH-58A, and AH-1J.
[*]Fixes to vehicle pathing: we have changed the decision process for path selection in several cases. Vehicles are to less likely to become stuck now.
[*]Loading screen visual improvements
[*]A key press (any key) is now required after loading in to a map, and before starting the combat round.
[*]Fixes to resolution scaling issues for several lobby menu's, especially the after combat report menu.
[*]Login screen now provides info about current patch and upcoming events (if there are any).
[*]New menu button in lobby screen - Tutorial, provides a list of links to tutorials and guides, at the moment there is only 1 guide, however, new guides will be added over time.

notes.title: The Road Ahead - Heliborne Roadmap Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/433530/header.jpg?t=1472545261[/img]
Greetings Pilots! We thought it was time to talk about our plans for Heliborne moving forward in greater detail. The level of detail that I think many of you may recall us promising some weeks ago. What is that detail? In short, we are sharing with you our road-map and plans for the development today, in full. So, let's get started.

[h1][b]Introduction to the Road-map[/b][/h1]
The Road-map as it stands in it's current version is divided in to three "Phases." Each phase represents a level of additional content, features, changes and updates that help push the game closer and closer to release, which is planned currently to be this December.

[h1][b]Phase One: Warm Up[/b][/h1]
Phase One is designed to move the game out of the view of being an "Alpha-state" product and more in to line with a Beta-State or "Pre-release" state product. We call this the "Warm Up" phase. Phase one will bring the following,
[list]
[*]Statistics: Full implementation, with rankings, leaderboards and other standard features related to Stats tracking in multiplayer titles. (This also includes heavy server improvements which are necessary for more advanced features later on in development.)
[*]Gamepad, Joystick and HOTAS support
[*]Flight Model improvements and updates. These features including things such as new physics updates, oscillation in a hover, etc *Features subject to change.
[*]Hangar and UI improvements with the addition of a new training ground map, and hangar scene. Thus allowing training and tutorials, as well as firing ranges and test flights. More on this later.
[*]Gameplay improvements, in-game communications and game ambiance.
[*]Unity analytics integration.
[*]Community: Events in-game on weekly basis as soon as statistics are introduced.
[/list]

[b]Deadline for Phase One Completion: End of September 2016[/b]

[h1][b]Phase Two: Pre-Release[/b][/h1]
Phase two is considered our actual "Pre Release Stage" and will see our actual promotional launch on a full scale. This stage will include the highest number of giveaways and promotional deals, as well as a high degree of media coverage. The following features are planned for Phase Two.
[list]
[*]Tutorial implementation.
[*]Progression system - fully implemented
[*]Basic matchmaking system
[*]Cheating prevention: VAC integration, distributed anti-cheating system (client instances will check their client instances for possible cheats)
[*]Cosmetic items - initial-pass
[*]Steam achievements integration
[*]Final Localization passes
[*]Community: Weekly events, and large giveaways
[*]Launch on new platforms (gog[dot]com, humble bundle and so on)
[*]Chinese release (full chinese localization + chinese helicopter + event)
[/list]

[b]Deadline for Phase Two Completion: First half of November 2016[/b]

[h1][b]Phase Three: Release[/b][/h1]
Phase Three will be our "Release Phase" in which we announce the final release date, as well as our "out of early access" price point increase. The following is planned for Phase Three.
[list]
[*]Cosmetic items - final pass
[*]Steam trading cards integration
[*]VoIP-chat (Subject to technology constraints, this may be a post-release feature or may not see integration. It is included here as part of the "Plan".)
[/list]
[b]Deadline for Phase Three: December 2016[/b]

[h1]Other News[/h1]
Now, I would be doing you a great disservice if I did not at least include screenies of one of the biggest things coming down the pipeline very soon. That being the new fullscale /map/ that the Hangar will be seamlessly integrated with to provide our training, testing, and firing range scenarios.

[h1]The Hangar Map[/h1]

This, Pilots, is the new Hangar map. This is where you will conduct training and tutorial missions. This map will also have a firing range, and will see the introduction of the ability for you to "test" any helo out FULLY, before taking it in to combat.

[h1]The New Squadron View[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KjrooTv.jpg[/img]
As you can see here, how you see and view your squadrons will change to showing you all three helos at the same time. We hope this helps show that you really are the leader of a "Squadron" of helicopters heading in to battle.

[h1]The new Helo Overview[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WQ6w8Hp.jpg[/img]
This pilots, is the new camera overview for looking at individual helos. Should be pretty self explanatory, we hope.


[h1]Closing Thoughts[/h1]
It's our hope with this announcement and our choice to share with you our final plans for features and updates, as well as these new screens of upcoming content, that we can show that we are truly dedicated to seeing Heliborne become a "released" title. notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/e34cb93a36c503784c8cd66af98df7c48f45eb0c.png[/img]

Greetings Pilots! Time for another patch!

- New helicopter - UH-1Y
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d6901d4262833d668f26f99d8ec393ccfb1448cf.jpg[/img]
- Battle timers added - 60 minutes maximum
- On Kosovo and Nguyen maps Landing Zones now produce attacking armored convoy every 3 minutes, you'll see progress bar on LZ UI icon notifiying you how ready this LZ is to produce attacking convoy. Attacking convoys move towards neutral and enemy points and try to capture them. Only fully captured LZ's (soldiers + vehicles) can produce attacking convoys
- Kosovo and Nguyen maps are updated, visual changes and camera changes as well as performance changes and notification when close to map border.

- All air-to-air missiles now have smaller turn rate
- All air-to-air missiles now have bigger explosion damage
- Amount of flares on helicopters now close to real values (considering amount of flares dropped with each launch)
- Flares now "blind" heat seeker lock-on for 5 seconds
- A new F1 help menu has been added.
- Mission objectives during loading screen have been added. Loading screen changed.
- Small flight parameter changes on several helicopters (mainly on AH-64D)
- Rocket damage has been slightly increased

[b]Operation Raging Fury[/b]
Heliborne got ya raging? Take out that Rage on the Dev Team this weekend during Operation Raging Fury. This special event will take place on the 6th and 7th of August. The following prime time zones are the hours you can expect to see Team Jet Cat on and flying,

[b]For the US Server:[/b] 
17:00 PDT to 21:00 PDT 06AUG2016 (All times are GMT-7)
17:00 PDT to 21:00 PDT 07AUG2016 (All times are GMT-7)

[b]For the EU Server:[/b] 
18:00 GMT+2 to 22:00 GMT+2 06AUG2016
18:00 GMT+2 to 22:00 GMT+2 07AUG2016

[b]For the SEA Server:[/b]
0800 GMT (1800AEST) to 1200 GMT (2200AEST) 06AUG2016
0800 GMT (1800AEST) to 1200 GMT (2200AEST) 07AUG2016

How do you know if the person you are shooting at is part of Team JetCat? You'll see us using a different color for our names and for our chat. We'll let you know when we're in the match! We'll be jumping from match to match to make sure we get in to a game with everyone that manages to get on. So come and shoot us down! (Also, feel free to ask questions to!)

[b]The Rules:[/b]
To enter the contest you must engage and shoot down a member of Team JetCat AND take a screenshot. Share that screenshot with the rest of the community in the screenshots section of the Steam Community Hub for Heliborne. We'll go over all the screenshots and pick 3 Winners at random.

[b]The Prize:[/b]
3 Players will recieve the following from Team JetCat
- A TeeShirt from Team JetCat in a size of your choosing
- 3 Keys to Heliborne to give to your friends
-One game off your steam wishlist! (Price not to exceed 30.00USD or your countries currency equivalent, this means a game that would cost you the same in your currency as 30.00USD)

notes.title: Version 0.39 and the "Squadrons" Update - Dev Blog
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/e34cb93a36c503784c8cd66af98df7c48f45eb0c.png[/img]


Greetings pilots! Rayne here with another dev blog, this time, as promised, we're going to be going over what's changing in update 0.39....


0.39, or "Squadrons" as we're calling it, adds the first pass off the squadron/deck building system to the game, as well as new mechanics such as the inability to switch teams during game-play, repair and rearm and timers for those features, and a host of bug fixes and improvements including a UI back-end replacement.

Let's get started shall we?

Firstly, when you log in for the first time post 0.39, you will be welcomed with the new lobby screen, in this screen, you can see your currently active Squadron, highlighted in orange, and buttons for Editing the Squadron and Changing the Active Squadron. You'll also see the "Create New Battle" button  which will allow you to start a new match. The way matches are made now has changed.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9c4f5c42dd3739a0365fa348151b32fa6203a211.jpg[/img]

In this screen, you can see that when you go to create a new battle, the match you can start is limited to the "Generations" of your current squadron. In this example, your squadron is Generation 1 and 2 helicopters, and can fight on both of our Viet Nam maps. As a note, when you go to join a  match in progress, the same rules apply. You'll see the Icon that denotes generation access as well as text that says "Helicopters of Generation "number" fight on this map." 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d7ef468afcd1442188a1f036ca830abcf2d33f92.jpg[/img]

When you enter a match, you are now greated with a "Selection" screen that shows your squadron as it stands, including repair timers that might also be on them should you need to respawn or repair them.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d83fc8f508320ce3afe361524ada211ae93574d3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/81319e16aca0558de7f2d517121d2f0a69924912.jpg[/img]

To leave a helicopter for repair, if it has not yet been shot down, simply land back at base and press "G" this brings up the selection screen, showing you the repair timer for all helos in your squadron that are being repaired. The more damage you have, the longer this process will take. Think of it like leaving the helo with the mechanics to perform field maintenance.

Also new in the update, is soldier replacement and weapon reloading also take time based on the number of soldiers, and the ammount and types of weapons. We're hoping to add a deeper level of tactical gameplay here. The risks you take with your aircraft, your men, and the weapons you use will have an effect when you return to base. So keep this in mind!

Now, on to the squadron system itself. When you click "edit squadron" you will be brought to the following screen,
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9e60e1bd8e4d98ae362112deca77c9373a67a080.jpg[/img]

Here you can see several pieces of information,
-The point value for your helo in it's current configuration in gold with a star directly above the helo.

Greetings pilots! Rayne here with another dev blog, this time, as promised, we're going to be going over what's changing in update 0.39....


0.39, or "Squadrons" as we're calling it, adds the first pass off the squadron/deck building system to the game, as well as new mechanics such as the inability to switch teams during game-play, repair and rearm and timers for those features, and a host of bug fixes and improvements including a UI back-end replacement.

Let's get started shall we?

Firstly, when you log in for the first time post 0.39, you will be welcomed with the new lobby screen, in this screen, you can see your currently active Squadron, highlighted in orange, and buttons for Editing the Squadron and Changing the Active Squadron. You'll also see the "Create New Battle" button  which will allow you to start a new match. The way matches are made now has changed.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9c4f5c42dd3739a0365fa348151b32fa6203a211.jpg[/img]

In this screen, you can see that when you go to create a new battle, the match you can start is limited to the "Generations" of your current squadron. In this example, your squadron is Generation 1 and 2 helicopters, and can fight on both of our Viet Nam maps. As a note, when you go to join a  match in progress, the same rules apply. You'll see the Icon that denotes generation access as well as text that says "Helicopters of Generation "number" fight on this map."

notes.title: Tell us all the things!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[/img]

[b]Greetings pilots![/b]
Firstly, we'd like to reach out yet again to all our great players that are helping us make heliborne great and giving us that much valued feedback. Without you all, we wouldn't be here and we realise that, and starting next week, we're going to be making strides to show you! How you might ask? Well, read below...

[b]On 0.38[/b]
Update 0.38 is progressing, and we should have it out on Thursday. Hopefully this gives us a few days after the update to get hotfixes out and quick changes out should anything break. As I said in the last announcement, there's a lot of mechanical changes coming to heliborne, a lot of new code, and gameplay et all, and while we try our best to make sure the patches we give you are spotless, this one might have some issues pop up. Rest assured, Team JetCat will be on hand all day to hear you feedback and make changes as soon as any issues crop up.

[b]On Future Updates[/b]
In regards to future updates, there might be some changes coming to the frequencey of the update cycle. As many of you have no doubt noticed, we've had to delay the weekly updates quite a few times lately. There's a myriad number of valid reasons for this, from large code changes, to integrating new team members, etc However, we feel it might be better if we move to a two-week update schedule from here on out so that we can provide patches that are more stable, as well as having more content in them. The next few updates are planned to be large, and with our goal to get Heliborne to a released state by December..we need to make sure the content we're putting out is on par. We'd like to hear you feedback on this! 

[b]On future Updates Part Deux..[/b]
Outside the update schedule I mentioned above, with a two week schedule, you can expect several more updates to the game before we shoot for a "release canadate". So, what can you expect to be coming over the following months?

[img]http://80.lv/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/2015-08-14-18-21-15-Heliborne-Tactical-helicopter-mulitplayer-arcade-Google-Chrome.png[/img]
Squadron/Deck building - This is the big one people have been waiting for, and it's coming! We're shooting for 0.39-0.40 area for this as there's a lot to it. 0.38 is adding a lot of the ground work for this system as was mentioned in my earlier update letter that was out earlier this week. With this first pass on this system you'll have 3 Slots to work with, and helicopters will cost points to field based on several factors. This system will be a first pass, so that means we can, and may change it with your feedback. 

[b]What else is coming?[/b]
[list]
[*]A new flight model, alongside changes in the base flight model adding things like "weight" as well as "crash situations" such as autorotation, crash landings, etc
[*]A fully featured stats tracking system that will keep you up to date on flight times, kills, deaths, etc
[*]New ground unit behavior
[*]New soldier types, such as the mortar team
[*]Reworked recon helicopter systems and gameplay
[/list]

This isn't all of it, but it's the start and a lot of it you can expect over the next few months. We hope you like these new features, and look forward to your feedback.


[b]For the community...[/b]
So, big announcement! JetCatgames is going to be at the following events,
[list]
[*]Digital Dragons - Poland - 16th and 17th of May
[*]Gamescom - Germany - 18th to the 21st of August
[*]EGX - London - 22nd to the 25th of September
[/list]

You can expect to see us at these events if you're in Europe, so stop by our booths and say hi! play the game, talk with us directly, etc! 

[b]As to our North American Friends,[/b]
You can expect to see me, aka "Rayne" at the Vectren Dayton International Airshow in Dayton Ohio on the 18th and 19th of June. I'll be hanging around the US Army Aviation Heritage Foundation's set up, which just so happens to have several AH-1 Cobra's and UH-1 Huey's that are still flying and that you can get rides on! That and spending time around the airshow proper. I'll be sure and get you more information on how to meet up with me directly before the show.

[b]What else can you expect community wise outside all that?[/b] 
 Join us on www.twitch.tv/jetcatgames for live Q and A sessions with guests, and gameplay during Digital Dragons on the 16th and 17th of May. 

We'll be moving to a weekly live stream schedule after this initial stream, so stay tuned for more!

Also, Team JetCat is happy to annuonce that we'll be hosting tournaments over the coming months with what we think are pretty amazing prizes, such as a large scale RC helicopter, custom artwork, in-game helo skins, and more! More info on this is coming in future update letters!
[img]http://www.scaleflying.com/assets/images/02-ah-1w-stbd-side.jpg[/img]

Well folks, that's about it. Just some quick notes for you. Hope you enjoyed this little letter and all the info in it. Feel free to ask questions and keep the feedback coming!
-Rayne
Team JetCat

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xDuV5t6.png[/img]

notes.title: Build 0.35 — Co-co-cobra!
Build 0.35 — Co-co-cobra!
Version 0.34!
notes.content:
Greetings pilots and happy patch day! Today we've got some bug fixes, weapons changes, and a new helo for you to enjoy. So have fun and be sure to give us that feedback!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/AHow7D0.jpg[/img]

- New helicopter - The AH-1J / AH-1J TOW International has been added
- All rockets and missiles now have their own models and textures
- ATGM's were fixed on some helicopters (Mi-1MU, OH-13S, and several others), they are now faster in flight.
- FFAR and Hydra rockets are now two different kinds of rockets, FFAR have a lower blast radius than Hydra rockets.
- Air-to-Air rockets now have bigger proximity detonation radius and a bit bigger lock-on sector
- There is now 'Rear view' button, which is X by default
- Hangar camera is updated, you can zoom in more now
- ATGM's are now harder to aim when moving

notes.content:

notes.title: 0.33 Is live!
notes.content:
This update isn't as large as we'd like, but we decided we needed to get an update in to your hands today regardless. So, what's new you ask? Let's take a look,

Firstly, you've got a new Helo on Nguyen Hue, the H-34, which replaces the UH-1D on that map.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RMxkICi.jpg[/img]

If you don't recognize this helo, then you've never seen full metal jacket,
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S06nIz4scvI

Let's take a look at the rest of the patch notes,
- The main HUD has been updated with a new artificial horizon.
- All 20mm and 23mm guns now cut off after 1-2 seconds of fire and have cooldown period of 1 second. This is the first step towards new ballistic weapon balancing.
- Grenade launchers on OH-6 and ACH-47 are now turreted as they should be
- The Mi-8MTV has lost its Falanga ATGM, this weapon system was replaced by UPK-23 gun pods.
- Mi-8TV has a new antenna block for ATGM targetting (and will have ATGM's in future)
- Mi-28 and Mi-28N rotor blades changed (were experimental version before, not mass-produced one)

Thanks to Vladislav Pakhomov for correcting us on Mi-8 and Mi-28 equipment.

We'd also like to show off some of the work our new level designer is doing in today's update, take a look!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KZPM9ih.jpg [/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IILHYv7.jpg [/img]

We'll have a lot more to start showcasing soon, so stay tuned for more!
-Rayne
TeamJetCat

notes.content:
This week is another small update as we work towards a new foundation for the future deck building and features list. Stay tuned for more info on the test server.
-Rayne

notes.title: Update 0.28
notes.content:
Greetings pilots! It's monday again and you know what that means...update time!

- Additional fixes towards better lag compensation and hit registration
- Different splashe effects when bullets hit other helo's
- Helo's now start to smoke for a while after being hit
- Miniguns are more precise now
- Rockets now have a bigger dispersion radius from the origin point. This means more dispersion lengthwise, not sideways.
- Some fixes with physics-related fps drops on nguyen map
- Early era light helicopters are bit more agile now


Expect additional content coming in 0.30 and 0.31, namely the ability to sling-load ammo crates and the deck building system! Also, the new Mortar troop should be ready in the next update or two. As normal, we will still maintain a heavy focus on optimization, performance, and general gameplay improvements.

Thank you all for your support as always, and we'll see you in the skies!
-Rayne
Team JetCat

notes.title: Version 0.27 "Fair Play"
notes.content:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[img]

- Collision detection model of all helicopters redone.
- Rockets have more ballistic qualities now, less accurate when shooting straight or up in the air.
- Rockets now have a smaller hitbox versus helicopters. Rocket fire against ground targets has not changed.
- Minigun bullet dispersion cones are widened by 20-25%
- Early ATGM's lifetime increased by 2 seconds
- Chinook landing module updated, it should now be easier to land.
- Fixed capture bar on Nguyen map
- Teambalancing - Forced locking of teams that have a high player advantage on respaw. This means you can no longer join the same team after being shot down, if the enemy team has a numerical advantage. (This change is temporary, and will be changed upon deck building update)
- Network quality and network debug added to settings
- Teamkillers are now kicked from the room and bared from re-entry. (We will monitor and adjust this over the coming days, expect a seconardy patch in a few days.)
- Audio fixes
- Several small bug fixes

Next week's update will also see some new content on top of our current performance focus. Stay tuned for more!
-Rayne
Team JetCat

notes.title: Version 0.24 Update and More!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[/img]

Greetings pilots! Today's a big one, so let's get to it shall we?

First off, We've updated the game to version 0.24. Patch notes follow,

[list]
[*]Version 1 of the OIS or the "Opponent Identification System" is now in place. This system is work in progress, and future updates will improve upon this first version. The OIS now changes the distance at which the "marker" above a Helicopter is detected by the player based on distance and altitude. Enemies are always ID'ed at 250 Meters. Maximum ID distance is now 750 meters.
[*]Ballistic trajectory version 1 added to unguided rockets. Visual effects changed slightly. Missile flight dynamics will continue to be updated in the future.
[*]Acceleration with nose up, and Decceleration with nose down pitch increased for all helicopters.
[*]All helicopters are now slightly faster in forward flight
[*]All helicopters now respond to "collective" lowering faster, this translates to faster decent speeds for all Helicopters.
[*]Markers above the friendly boats are back.
[*]Boats on Tonkin were weakened (accuracy and lethality of weapons)
[*]Improvement of lag compensation ( we will continue to work on this)
[*]Bug with unkillable AA guns fixed, as well as bug with uncapturing points (when it was marked as captured by the enemy, although there was no any ground troops) fixed.
[*]UI bugs fixed: no choosing server buttons in 4:3 aspect ration, freezing screen after disconnection from server or attempt to enter a full room.
[*]Helicopters crashed nearby the initial bases disappear faster
[*]Entering match in Camera mode temporarily removed
[/list]

[h1]*NOTE* You will need to close the game and apply the update. The next update will be a normal server restart with a server wide message.[/h1]


Next, we're moving to new forums! The old SMF forums are being shut down, and we have launched new forums here,

forums.jetcatgames.com

Registration is open to ALL, and automatic. So head on over! They're live with this announcement.


Moving on, the first week has gone well! Heliborne has reached over 5,000 copies sold! We can't thank you all enough for your feedback and support. We couldn't do this without you.

Additionally,
JetCatGames is now reaching out for a new programmer and 3D Artist. If you're interested, please send your resume/CV and portfolio to contact@jetcatgames.com


Last but not least,
With the closure of the Alpha Forums and the opening of the new Public forums, as well as this current update, the Heliborne Alpha is now closing. This means that to continue to play the current version of Heliborne, you will need to purchase it via Steam.

To all our Alpha Testers, thank you so much for your dedication, interest, and support!
-Team JetCat
